data.title: People Operations Specialist
data.description:
Streaming TV is no longer just a brand awareness channel. It’s becoming a core part of the performance marketing mix, alongside search and social. Vibe.co is building the platform that makes TV work like the rest of the acquisition stack: targeted, measurable, and optimized for results.

Vibe.co is an Audience First Streaming TV Advertising platform that gives marketers the tools to reach the right audiences, optimize campaigns in real time, and understand what’s actually driving business outcomes. With hyper-targeted segmentation, AI-powered recommendations, real-time optimization, and incrementality measurement, Vibe brings the precision and accountability of digital advertising to the biggest screen in the house.

Today, more than 12,000 brands use Vibe.co to reach 120 million+ households. And in August 2026, Vibe.co became a Walmart company, opening up a new chapter for the business and the industry. With Walmart’s first-party data and purchase signals now part of the Vibe platform, advertisers can connect TV advertising to real-world transactions and measure the impact of CTV with a level of precision previously associated with platforms like Google and Meta.

This is a unique moment to join Vibe. With Walmart’s scale, data, and reach behind us, we’re building the next generation of TV advertising and creating a more measurable, performance-driven future for the channel.

About the Role

You'll join People Ops, the Systems and Operations pillar of the People team. It owns payroll, HRIS, onboarding and offboarding, contracts, benefits, and compliance across France, the US, and our remote geographies. You'll report to Melissa, our Senior Global HR Systems and Operations Manager in Paris. We're opening this role because Vibe is scaling fast across regions, and payroll plus People Ops now need a dedicated owner who keeps the engine running and makes it better. If you want real ownership of payroll from day one, a front-row seat to how an international team actually operates across three geographies, and the room to reshape and automate the work as you go, this is the seat.

What You'll Do

Payroll and contractors

  • Run the monthly French payroll cycle with our external provider, from variable inputs to final validation.

  • Check every payslip before sign-off to catch errors before they reach employees.

  • Keep EOR payroll on schedule across our remote geographies.

  • Own contractor operations end to end, from timesheet collection to the Finance provisioning file.

  • Reconcile each cycle to catch what doesn't add up before it’s live.

People operations and HR admin

  • Manage employment documents for a team spread across France, the US, and remote.

  • Administer benefits: enrollments, changes, and the questions employees bring.

  • Run onboarding and offboarding logistics so every joiner and leaver lands cleanly.

Employee support

  • Serve as first point of contact for employees on People questions.

  • Triage incoming requests through our ticketing system against agreed SLAs.

  • Research individual employee cases across policy, contracts, and local labour law.

Systems and projects

  • Maintain HRIS data hygiene and the workflows behind it.

  • Drive People Ops projects end to end, with clear scope, deadlines, and stakeholders.

What You Need

  • 3+ years in payroll, HR administration, or People Ops. An apprenticeship or internship counts.

  • Strong knowledge of French payroll and labour law fundamentals: contracts, absences, final pay, health and provident cover.

  • Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills and real comfort working with numbers.

  • Project management basics: you've run something with a real deadline and a scope that moved.

  • Experience with an HRIS.

  • Fluent French and English. English is our working language.

Nice to Haves

  • Hands-on experience in a ticketing tool.

  • Exposure to international or EOR payroll.

  • Comfort building automations to cut manual work.

  • Experience at a scale-up.

Our Values

At Vibe, we run on three values: Impact, Ambition, and Urgency. We tie every goal to a real business outcome, think 10x rather than settling for good enough, and move daily rather than waiting for perfect conditions.

You'll thrive here if you own outcomes without needing direction, default to action, and hold yourself to results, not effort.

This is a high-performance environment with high-performance rewards: you'll work alongside people who push you, with real ownership over hard problems in a market that's moving fast.

If that sounds like the best version of your career, we want to meet you.

What We Offer

For candidates in France, the base pay range for this role is €45k–€65k, plus variable. We will support relocation to Paris for great candidates.

At Vibe, we want you to build something, own something, and grow fast. Here's how we back that up:

  • Equity — Employee Stock Ownership Plan. You're building this; you should own part of it.

  • Variable pay — Based on real Vibe business goals.

  • Hybrid flexibility — We're in the Heart of Paris and our team is in 3x a week!

  • Health insurance — Full coverage via Alan.

  • Meal vouchers — Via Swile.

  • Annual offsite — The whole team, once a year, somewhere worth the trip.

  • Tech Syncs — Engineering and Product meet in person at least quarterly, worldwide.

Our Interview Process

We respect your time. Here's exactly what to expect, no surprises, no ghosting.

  • Recruiter screen — 30 min. We'll share context; you'll share yours.

  • Manager interview — Meet the person you'd work with directly.

We are looking for a Principal to lead global campaign operations at Prosci. You will turn Marketing plans for our Individual and Enterprise audiences into consistent, well-built campaigns across regions. 

You will own how campaigns are planned, built, tested and measured in HubSpot. You will direct a specialist partner team, and set the standards that let regional marketers move quickly while maintaining quality and governance. 

This is a hands-on leadership role. You will be our senior Marketing-side expert in campaign operations and HubSpot, setting the operating model, standards and quality bar while directing specialist delivery support. You should be comfortable building and troubleshooting when needed, but your main job is making the whole campaign operation work well at scale.

Requirements

What you will do 

  • Partner with Individual, Enterprise and regional Marketing leaders to translate demand strategy into scalable campaign execution 
  • Own the end-to-end campaign process, from brief and plan to build, launch, QA and measurement, across email, nurture, webinars, events and landing pages 
  • Set global campaign standards, templates and processes that regional teams can use with confidence 
  • Act as the senior Marketing expert on how HubSpot is used for campaigns, including audiences, segmentation and automation 
  • Direct and quality-check the work of our specialist partner team 
  • Define campaign measurement requirements, and make sure every campaign has the right taxonomy, tracking and data structure so Marketing can understand what is working 
  • Own Marketing campaign activation across the website, including landing pages, forms, conversion paths and related content updates, working with Digital Experience on platform, development and broader website improvements 
  • Identify opportunities to automate, simplify and standardize campaign operations, including appropriate use of AI 
  • Work with RevOps on lifecycle, routing and CRM data, and with reporting partners on what needs measuring 
  • Enable regional marketers to execute more independently, with clear standards, templates and guardrails 


What you bring 

  • 7+ years in marketing operations, including campaigns across multiple regions or markets 
  • Deep, hands-on HubSpot Marketing Hub experience: workflows, lists, segmentation, email, landing pages and forms 
  • A working understanding of how HubSpot and Salesforce connect, and the judgment to know when a problem belongs with the CRM team 
  • Experience directing agency or partner teams and holding them to a clear quality standard 
  • A strong QA instinct: you catch the issue before it reaches a customer or a report 
  • Strong campaign measurement fluency, including tracking, UTMs, attribution concepts and the data foundations required for reliable analysis 
  • Clear writing, and the ability to explain technical trade-offs to non-technical colleagues 


Nice to have 

  • HubSpot certifications 
  • Experience with consent and privacy requirements across regions, including GDPR 
  • Experience supporting ABM or BDR-led motions 
  • Localization and multilingual campaign experience 
  • Practical use of AI tools to automate or speed up campaign work 


How you will work with other teams 

Revenue Systems owns shared CRM administration and governance. Digital Experience leads the website platform and technical roadmap. Reporting partners own routine reporting delivery. You will work closely with each of these teams to make campaigns effective, measurable and well run. 

Your first 90 days 

  1. First 30 days: learn the campaign estate, the partner model and regional needs, and see where QA currently catches problems 
  1. By 60 days: run the campaign process end to end, and set the briefing and QA rhythm with the partner team 

By 90 days: establish the initial global campaign standards, templates and operating rhythm, and agree campaign measurement requirements with Marketing leadership and reporting partners

Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

⭐ SECURITY ASSOCIATE INTERNSHIP ⭐

Six-month end-of-studies internship in Paris.

Looking for an end-of-studies internship where you do real cybersecurity work, not a side project nobody uses? Alan protects the health data of more than 1M members, and keeping it safe is part of everyday work here.

You join the Security team as a full member for six months. Topics span from compliance and certifications to vulnerabilities, detection and incident response, and you have room to pick the ones where you can have the most impact. A dedicated coach guides you and supervises your thesis. The goal at the end is a full-time job at Alan.

⭐ DETAILED MISSIONS ⭐

Alan is opening new countries, and each one brings more audits, certifications and customer security reviews. Possible topics span from governance and compliance to hands-on technical work. You won't do all of them: with your coach, you choose the ones that matter most for Alan and for you.

  • Governance, risk and compliance: ISO 27001 and HDS (French health data hosting) certifications, statutory IT audit, customer security reviews, risk management

  • Vulnerability management: triage reports and scanner findings, drive fixes with engineering teams, improve our tooling

  • Detection and response: write detection rules, investigate alerts, support the team on incidents

  • Build: technical projects you own from framing to adoption. Past projects: an internal pentest for an audit, code scanning and remediation, an HDS internal audit, tooling proofs of concept

  • Automate what repeats, so the team spends its time where the risk is

⭐ KEY OUTCOMES ⭐

By the end of the internship, you will have:

  • Owned a recurring security campaign end to end and left it cheaper for the next round

  • Shipped one technical project to real users

  • Written your end-of-studies thesis on a real security subject

  • Worked with engineers and senior people across the company

⭐ PROFILE & COMPETENCIES ⭐

  • End of studies: engineering or security track, looking for a six-month internship

  • Security foundations: solid basics in security and IT, and you can apply them to a concrete case

  • You code: Python at least, and you automate the repetitive part

  • Curiosity: you dig into topics you don't master yet, and you are curious about compliance, not only offensive security

  • Risk sense: you know not every risk is equal, and some trade-offs are worth taking

  • Collaboration: you work with engineers, not against them, and look for solutions that work for both sides

  • Clear communication: structured and written, in English (French is a plus)

  • Bonus: CTFs, personal security projects, a previous security internship, cloud or SaaS experience

🙌 Perks & Benefits


At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.
Therefore, we offer:

  • Flexible Office. Amazing office space at our HQ, sponsored co-working hubs or a full-remote experience with home office equipment sponsorship, we want you to live where you’re the happiest.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish.

  • Transport. Country-specific commuter benefits.

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible Training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

  • Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. 📈 Finance community at Alan

Finance & Strategy exists to enable better decisions, faster, at every level of the company, in a regulated, diverse and ever-changing business.

We succeed when ambitious goals become credible plans, when strategic bets are grounded in financial reality, and when the entire company (not just Finance!) speaks the language of performance.

We set the right ambition, we monitor whether we're getting there, and we raise our hand when something needs to change.

We are not record-keepers. We are builders, partners, and challengers. We are looking for people who want to build, support decision-making processes and challenge the status quo.

The core responsibilities of the Finance & Strategy community are:

  • Strategy & Planning: steers Alan's financial performance through business planning, financial and operational monitoring, investor relations and financing

  • Financial Reporting: is the steward of Alan's financial truth, ensuring that we produce accurate, timely financial data. It owns the reporting to all key stakeholders (board, leadership team, tax authorities, and regulators like the ACPR) and ensures that financial data is the single, uncontested source of truth for the company's performance

  • Finance Data and Operations: Build and own the core finance data and tooling infrastructure (models, pipelines, and concepts that connect business operations to financial reality). This is where Finance meets product thinking

  • Functional poles with end-to-end ownership of their domain: Treasury, Procurement, M&A

⭐️ The insurance controller role ⭐️

Our insurance scope is growing fast: more complex reinsurance treaties, prévoyance (disability and death cover) moving in-house, new products and markets. At the same time, Finance is taking over the Solvency 2 balance sheet, which will be audited from 2028.

We’re looking for a rigorous, ownership-driven insurance finance professional to own our prévoyance technical flows and the production of the Solvency 2 balance sheet. You’ll join the Financial Controlling team (within Financial Reporting) and act as the hub between Risk, Actuarial, Ops, Data and Strategy, as well as the main contact for our reinsurers and external auditors.

You’ll know these numbers inside out: how they’re produced, what business reality they reflect, and how to defend them to auditors, the ACPR and the Board. You read the source texts yourself (accounting rules, Solvency 2 regulation, treaty clauses), form your own view, and know when to escalate.

⭐️ What you will do ⭐️

  • Prévoyance flows: own premiums, claims, technical provisions (mathematical and claims reserves) and related reinsurance, from P&L through balance sheet and cash

  • Reinsurance accounting: manage reinsurance accounts, quarterly settlements and profit-sharing clauses, making sure the books reflect what our treaties actually say

  • Solvency 2 balance sheet (solo and group): restate French GAAP to Solvency 2, challenge actuarial best estimates and risk margin, and track own funds quarter to quarter

  • Regulatory reporting: prepare balance sheet and own-funds QRTs and write the balance-sheet section of the SFCR

  • Audit readiness: be the single point of contact for auditors on Solvency 2, starting with the 2027 dry run, with documentation and controls always ready

  • Monthly review: analyse and comment on your scope (P&L, balance sheet, variances, loss ratio and other insurance KPIs)

  • Automation: turn manual computations into clear specs for our Finance Data team, and use data and AI to make closing faster and more reliable

  • Business partnering: flag the accounting and solvency impact of new products, treaties or markets early and follow through to implementation

⭐️ What we’re looking for ⭐️

  • At least 5 years in insurance accounting, ideally Big 4 insurance audit followed by finance or reporting at an insurer

  • Strong command of French GAAP insurance accounting (technical provisions, reinsurance, insurance P&L)

  • Hands-on experience with the Solvency 2 balance sheet and QRTs

  • Strong analytical skills: reconciling large datasets, bridging French GAAP to Solvency 2, spotting inconsistencies; comfortable with SQL and AI tools

  • Organised, rigorous and comfortable building structure from ambiguity; you close the loops and can explain technical topics to actuaries, auditors and non-finance stakeholders alike

  • Fluent in English and French

Big pluses: prévoyance experience (long-term reserves, mortality/disability tables, profit-sharing), having built a Solvency 2 production process, actuarial knowledge, IFRS 17.

🌍 How we work

  • Location: You must be legally eligible to work from France. The role is based in Paris.

data.description:
🐼 Pourquoi Prévenir

Prévenir est un nouveau Service de Prévention et de Santé au Travail Interentreprises (SPSTI) en Île-de-France.

Notre ambition est de repenser la santé au travail pour améliorer l'impact sur la vie des salariés et l'expérience des professionnels de santé, en s'appuyant sur les moyens technologiques d'Alan.

Notre premier centre médical a ouvert ses portes au 117 Quai de Valmy (Paris 10ᵉ) et ce n'est que le début !

👉 Pour en savoir plus sur le quotidien chez Prévenir, c'est ici

💉 Le poste, concrètement

Vous êtes IDEST au sein d'une équipe pluridisciplinaire (médecins du travail, ASST, IPRP) avec laquelle vous co-construisez la pratique de Prévenir. Votre temps se répartit entre :

  • Visites individuelles, en présentiel au centre de Valmy (Paris 10e) et en distanciel, sous protocole de délégation avec le médecin du travail, repérage précoce des situations à risque (désinsertion, RPS, addictions)

  • Actions de prévention en milieu professionnel pendant le tiers temps dédié : interventions individuelles et collectives, webinaires thématiques (TMS, RPS, hygiène de vie, écrans…), supports digitaux, parcours de prévention innovants

  • Innovation et amélioration continue : test et déploiement de nouveaux outils numériques en santé au travail, conseil à l'équipe Prévenir sur les outils et procédures à déployer, contribution à l'optimisation des protocoles, etc.

  • Selon l'expérience : participation à la cellule PDP, prise en charge de visites de reprise et visites à la demande sous protocole de délégation.

Ce qui change vs. un SPSTI classique :

  • Une équipe pluridisciplinaire à co-construire. Vous ne rejoignez pas un service figé : vous participez à dessiner la place de l'IDEST chez Prévenir, les protocoles de délégation avec les médecins, et les passerelles avec ASST et IPRP

  • Des outils numériques co-construits avec vous. Une équipe d'ingénieurs et de designers Alan développe avec les soignants les outils dont ils ont besoin — DMST, parcours de prévention, supports de webinaires, expérimentations IA

  • Le mix présentiel / distanciel pensé comme un atout métier. Vous voyez les salariés et les entreprises sur le terrain quand c'est utile, et vous gardez le temps et les outils pour faire de la prévention de qualité à distance le reste du temps

Indispensable :

  • Diplôme d'État d'infirmier·e

  • 3 ans d'expérience en santé au travail après DIUST

  • Excellentes compétences en communication et capacité à établir une relation de confiance avec les salariés et les adhérents

Idéalement :

  • Aisance pour animer un webinaire ou un atelier collectif, en présentiel comme en visio

data.description:
🐙 Rejoins la révolution énergétique chez Octopus Energy !
 
Octopus Energy, fournisseur d’énergie verte présent à l’international, a lancé sa filiale Octopus Energy Services pour accompagner ses clients dans la décarbonation complète de leur foyer. Déjà bien implantée au Royaume-Uni, cette entité propose un ensemble de solutions techniques : installation de panneaux photovoltaïques, de bornes de recharge pour véhicules électriques et de systèmes de chauffage décarboné, le tout avec une approche centrée sur la qualité, l’innovation et sans sous-traitance.
 
Tu veux un job qui a du sens ? Octopus Energy Services a démarré son activité en 2024, avec un objectif clair : aider les particuliers à réduire leurs factures énergétiques tout en participant activement à la transition énergétique. Et aujourd’hui on a besoin de toi pour propulser notre croissance !

Nous sommes aujourd’hui une cinquantaine de salariés et nous visons 10 M€ de chiffre d'affaires en 2027, ce qui nous placera parmi les leaders du marché. Le cap derrière : que tout client qui veut s'équiper pense à nous en premier, parce que nous sommes la référence sur la qualité de l'accompagnement et des produits que nous vendons.

Pour tenir ce cap, nous nous structurons en trois BU : 

  • La BU Solaire reste notre activité historique et notre cœur de métier : vente et pose avec nos propres installateu·rices.

  • Notre réseau de Partenaires Certifiés, pour accompagner les clients sur des travaux que nous ne proposons pas en propre (vente et pose de pompe à chaleur notamment).

  • Le matériel, afin de lancer sur le marché français les produits fabriqués par le groupe, comme sa pompe à chaleur Cosy, que l’on souhaite proposer à nos Partenaires Certifiés. 

Guillaume, Directeur Général Délégué, qui a lancé la filiale, supervisera les trois et cherche la personne qui dirigera la BU Solaire, notre activité historique.

Ta mission :

Tu diriges la BU Solaire comme un·e véritable dirigeant·e de business : tu fixes le cap, tu portes les résultats et tu construis l'organisation qui nous fera passer à l'échelle. Ton premier chantier : monter en cadence de pose, sans dégrader la qualité, tout en améliorant la rentabilité de la BU en 2027. Tu le fais depuis le terrain autant que depuis le bureau.

Tes responsabilités seront les suivantes : 


1. Stratégique : Définir le cap et faire grandir la BU.

Tu portes la vision, la stratégie de développement de la BU et tu prends les arbitrages structurants, notamment :

  • Fixer la trajectoire de la BU et trancher les décisions qui font avancer le business ;

  • Décider, le moment venu, des extensions : nouvelle zone géographique, nouvelle ligne de produit ;

  • Représenter la BU en interne et faire l'interface avec Octopus Energy France (fourniture d'énergie, offre bundlée pose + contrat + pilotage batterie), les fonctions support partagées et les deux autres BU.


    • 2. Économique : Piloter le P&L, la rentabilité et les investissements

    Tu es owner des chiffres de la BU, tu devras notamment :

  • Suivre la rentabilité à chaque maillon de la chaîne (vente, étude, pose, SAV) et les faire suivre à chaque manager ;

  • Travailler avec eux à les améliorer : coût d'acquisition, délais de pose, SAV ;

  • Produire les chiffres du reporting groupe et savoir les défendre.


    • 3. Managériale et opérationnelle : Faire grandir les managers et structurer l'organisation.

    Tu fais monter les responsables de chaque équipe pour qu’ils portent la montée en cadence de la BU dans une organisation qui grandit : 

  • Accompagner les managers d’équipe au quotidien pour qu'ils·elles fassent grandir ses équipes, y compris dans les moments difficiles ;

  • Structurer, avec les équipes techniques, la montée en cadence de pose ;

  • Animer le collectif et incarner la culture de l'entreprise : exigence de qualité, jalons, victoires célébrées.


    • Ce qu'on cherche :

    Ce qui compte d'abord, c'est qui tu es : 

  • Tu t’intéresses vraiment aux gens, tu es exigeant·e et tu dis les choses clairement, dans le respect de la personne en face.

  • Tu sais engager des équipes pluridisciplinaires : commerce, administratif, technique et terrain ne parlent pas la même langue, tu fais le lien.

  • Tu accompagnes tes managers pour qu'ils fassent monter leurs propres équipes.

  • Tu es à l'aise dans une entreprise en construction : on teste, on se trompe, on recommence.

  • Tu prends ton sujet en main et tu as le courage managérial de dire les choses.

  • Tu es proactif·ve, tu trouves des solutions en autonomie et tu fais s'activer les équipes autour de toi.

    • Côté compétences techniques :

  • Tu as déjà dirigé une activité opérationnelle avec des équipes de terrain. Le solaire résidentiel n'est pas obligatoire.

  • Tu lis un P&L et tu défends tes chiffres devant une direction.

  • Tu as une vraie vision business : tu relies l'opérationnel à la rentabilité.

  • Tu es prêt·e à aller sur le terrain, régulièrement.

  • Tu sais communiquer (écrit et oral) en anglais pour échanger avec le Groupe. 

    • Conditions :

  • Contrat : CDI – Statut Cadre

  • Localisation : Paris ou Lille (déplacements à prévoir entre les deux bureaux et sur le terrain)

  • Date de prise de poste : Dès que possible

  • Rémunération : À définir selon profil et expérience

    •  

    Processus de recrutement :

    1. Premier échange avec Chloé, notre Talent Partner en charge de ce recrutement 

    2. Échange visio de 30 min avec Guillaume pour comprendre tes motivations pour le poste 

    3. Entretien en présentiel à Paris ou Lille avec Guillaume et potentiellement un échange avec un des membres du COMEX Octopus France

    Pourquoi tu vas adorer travailler pour nous ?

    Tu veux connaitre le salaire ? Demande-le nous ! Lors de notre premier contact, c’est un point que nous abordons toujours, car même si nous prenons soin de définir des grilles les plus justes possibles, il nous semble également important de faire correspondre ton expérience au bon salaire. Nous aurons l’occasion de t’en dire plus sur la manière dont nous avons défini le salaire et sur les autres avantages dont tu pourras bénéficier si tu nous rejoins ! Sache enfin que nous pouvons avoir un certain degré de flexibilité, car nous ne voudrions jamais que le salaire soit une raison pour laquelle quelqu’un·e ne postule pas chez Octopus - ce qui est le plus important pour nous est de trouver le bon Octofit !

    Certifiée depuis 2024 et 4e en 2025, Octopus Energy France est classée 1ère sur plus de 200 entreprises au classement Great Place to Work 2026 ! Cela reflète bien notre engagement pour un environnement de travail épanouissant !

    Nous sommes une organisation où les gens apprennent, décident et construisent plus rapidement. Où ils travaillent de manière autonome, avec des gens extraordinaires, sur des projets qui innovent. Intéressement au capital, flex-office, excellente mutuelle, forfait mobilité douce, prise en charge d’une partie de ton titre de transport au-delà du minimum légal, et même des jours de congés spéciaux pour t’investir dans un projet associatif qui te tient à coeur… Nous voulons que ton investissement soit récompensé par des avantages auxquels tu tiens vraiment !

    Chez Octopus, nous cherchons des personnes foncièrement bienveillantes et empathiques. L’égalité des chances nous tient à cœur et nous veillons à offrir un environnement de travail inclusif et équitable. Nous t’invitons à postuler, quels que soient ton âge, genre, vie conjugale, couleur, handicap, grossesse ou parentalité, origine, convictions religieuses ou orientation sexuelle.

data.title: Staff Engineer Platform
data.description:
🪐 Discover our galaxy
 
Join the Future of Work ! Malt is Europe's leading freelance marketplace, connecting over 1,000,000 talented freelancers with 100,000+ companies. Founded in 2013, we're transforming how work gets done through our tech-powered, human-centered platform. What makes us different:
 
- A diverse team of 600 Malters across 6 European countries
- A culture that champions equality (50% of our Comex are women) and inclusive growth
- Backed by top investors including ISAI, Serena Capital, Eurazeo Growth, Goldman Sachs, and BPI
- A mission to give everyone the freedom to work differently
 
Ready to help shape the future of work? Your next chapter starts here! 🪐
 
At Malt we believe that Ambition is the Way, so all lists of missions and responsibilities are non-exhaustive.

Key responsibilities

  • Set the Long-Term Platform Tech Strategy: Define the 2–3 year technical vision and roadmap for Malt's engineering platform — backend, frontend — alongside platform leads, ensuring architectural consistency, security, and high reliability across all engineering squads. Agentic capabilities are a central pillar of that vision, not a side project.

  • Architect Platform Foundations: Partner closely with Backend, Frontend, and SRE leads to design and build our company-wide platform foundations — from core shared infrastructure through to our agentic layer, consolidating existing POCs into unified, enterprise-grade capabilities.

  • Pioneer Agentic DevEx Workflows: Prototype, scale, and embed autonomous AI agents into the software development lifecycle (e.g., agentic MR reviews, automated code quality, and security fixes) so product teams can focus strictly on core product logic.

  • Deliver Platform-as-a-Product: Provide product engineers with self-service tools, reusable components, clear guardrails, and documentation making both our platform foundations and our autonomous workflows the natural, default way to ship software at Malt.

  • Build, Hands-On: Contribute directly to the platform. You'll write production code on the systems you design: the hardest parts, the reference implementations, the things nobody else can unblock.

  • Raise the Bar: Drive the adoption of best practices, coding standards, and high-quality engineering processes, including thorough code and architecture reviews. Foster operational excellence across the platform.

  • Mentor and Coach: Provide technical guidance and mentorship to engineers across the platform team, particularly Senior and mid-level engineers, helping them develop their skills, master agentic patterns, and advance their careers.

  • Drive Technical Alignment & Change Management: Act as a technical catalyst, influencing and aligning backend, frontend, and engineering leads around transformative AI agent paradigms without relying on top-down authority.


    • About you

  • Technical Expertise: You have 15+ years of professional experience in software engineering, including a proven track record operating at a Staff or Principal level in high-scale platform environments. You're highly proficient in Kotlin or Java, comfortable across GCP and modern web frameworks (e.g. Nuxt/VueJS), and at ease navigating complex backend architecture, APIs, and data models.

  • AI-Driven Innovator: Passionate about AI topics, you regularly keep up to date with the latest developments. You have already built product-grade agentic workflows within the software development lifecycle: systems engineers rely on daily to review, test, or ship code, not demos or POCs.

  • Clear leadership: You excel at working effectively in uncertain and evolving environments, managing the interaction between technical objectives and business priorities.

  • Platform as a Product Mindset: You think beyond the code. Your product is the developer experience: you're curious about the "why" behind the workflows, core components you build, proactive in proposing improvements, and you own delivery from A to Z: including the adoption, not just the architecture.

  • Resourceful: You always find a way of getting things done, even under severe staffing constraints.

  • Impactful: You demonstrate excellent ownership and problem-solving skills, with a high degree of agency in driving solutions.

  • Strong interpersonal abilities: You possess excellent written and oral communication skills in English (French is a valuable bonus).


    • How to join the mission?

    1. Initial Screening Call (45m): First exchange with Luke Singh or Alexandre Hidasi (Tech & Product Recruiters) to explore your background, career aspirations, and answer any initial questions.

    2. Manager Interview (60m): Deep dive into your technical background, domain experience, and alignment with Anaïs Ghelfi (Hiring Manager & Engineering Director).

    3. Technical Business Case & Debrief (2h): Practical architecture exercise and debrief with Staff Engineers to evaluate your systems design and agentic architecture mastery.

    4. Executive & Culture Fit Interview (2h): Final conversation with Claire (CTO) to discuss Malt’s long-term vision, followed by an informal coffee chat with Raphaël Ouazana & Pierre Reynaud.

    Malt is the perfect space to thrive personally and professionally 💫
     
    - Onboarding: Before easing into your new role, you’ll spend your first week learning about our culture, products, and services with other new joiners at our office in Paris
    - Equity: Every Malter is entitled to stock options

    - Transportation (legal benefit): 50% reimbursement (any type of transport)
    - Healthcare insurance (legal benefit) 
    - RTT: From 8 to 12 days off per year
    - Sports: Company participation to a Gymlib (Wellpass) membership
    - Malt sabbatical: Every three years, all Malters are entitled to a one month fully paid sabbatical leave
    - Free books: If you’re interested in learning more about any topic relevant to Malt’s business, just tell us the books you’d like to read, and we’ll order them for you—without any questions asked or approval processes to follow
    - Remote work: Hybrid policy balancing on-site and home office
    - Team building events organized every year
     
    Ready? Get your ticket to Malt 🪐 
     
    At Malt, we are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace. We recruit based on skills, experience, and potential, without any form of discrimination related to age, gender, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, or disability. Our mission is to create a work environment where everyone feels valued, respected, and safe to thrive.

data.title: Security & Compliance Engineer – GRC & Product Security – Security and IT Team
data.description:
About Scality

Scality solves organisations' biggest data storage challenges: growth, security, performance, and cost. Designed for end-to-end cyber resilience, only Scality S3 object storage with CORE5 safeguards data at every level of the system, from API to architecture. Its patented MultiScale Architecture enables limitless, independent scalability in all critical dimensions to meet the unpredictable demands of modern workloads. The world's most discerning companies depend on Scality to accelerate high-performance AI initiatives, optimize cloud deployments, and defend their data with confidence. Recognized as a leader by Gartner, Scality software is reliable, secure, and sustainable.


The job context

The team

Our IT & Security team builds, runs and secures Scality's IT infrastructure. It also supports the whole Scality community: employees, contractors, consultants and freelancers. We make sure everyone works in a secure, compliant and up-to-date environment. We also bring security expertise to our products (RING, ARTESCA, ADI) and to our customers.

You will join a team of 4 to 5 people with varied backgrounds (development, security, IT operations, helpdesk) and 2 to 30+ years of experience.

The mission

You will own Scality's information security compliance program and coordinate the team's security operations. You will lead our ISO 27001 and ISO 42001 (AI management system) certifications and manage vulnerability (CVE) follow-up with Engineering. 

You will answer customer security requests and audits. You will also help our products meet new regulations such as the EU Cyber Resilience Act (CRA).

The role is about 70% governance, risk and compliance (GRC) and product security, and 30% hands-on security operations.


The job description

You will own (Responsible)

  • Security operations coordination: be the point of contact for incoming IT & Security requests, prioritize them and dispatch them within the team.
  • Vulnerability management: Assess product exposure to CVEs by leveraging internal tools powered by our Software Bills of Materials (SBOMs).. Handle customer security requests (RD tickets) with Engineering and Support until a fix version or a customer answer is delivered. Track scan and pentest reports through remediation.
  • ISO 27001 and ISO 42001 programs: maintain the framework, policies and procedures in our GRC tool. Run risk analysis and treatment plans, objectives and indicators, and the Statement of Applicability. Prepare internal and external audits and follow up on nonconformities and improvement opportunities.
  • Control management: run the monthly, quarterly and annual controls (account and access reviews across HR system and SSO, application access, offboarding checks), automate them in Jira and keep audit evidence.
  • ISMS processes: run security incident management and change management in Jira (workflows, fields, records), and the business continuity part of customer requests (ISO 22301-type questionnaires).
  • Third-party and application security reviews: assess new SaaS tools, suppliers and internal applications or automations (no-code tools, Slack or AI integrations). Keep the supplier inventory and the service account inventory up to date.
  • AI governance: maintain the AI systems inventory, review the AI features of tools before use, and follow regulatory changes (EU AI Act).
  • Personal data: maintain the personal data inventory and processing records (GDPR, CNIL guidance) together with the data protection contact.
  • Customer trust: answer security questionnaires and RFPs, and prepare evidence packages for customer audits (banking, telecom and public-sector customers).
  • Security awareness: plan and run awareness and phishing campaigns, and track participation and click rates for managers.

    • You will contribute to (Contributor)

  • Product security and certifications: prepare the EU Cyber Resilience Act (CRA) technical files per product (compliance matrix, risk assessment, SBOM, vulnerability handling, RACI). Also contribute to CISA Secure by Design commitments and UK Cyber Essentials. Bring security input to the product roadmap, the development teams and the product documentation.
  • Data leak prevention: define and tune DLP indicators and alerts (Google Workspace, Salesforce event monitoring) and investigate alerts.
  • Infrastructure security: IaaS/PaaS security, monitoring and SIEM alerting, reporting of security incidents, business continuity and disaster recovery.
  • Automation and tooling: scripts (Python, Bash) and Jira automations that reduce manual work.
  • IT operations: account, application and permission management, level 1 and 2 network and security incidents.
  • Mentoring: onboard and supervise interns or work-study students on security topics.

    • You will be informed of

    Laptop fleet and IT room hardware, SSO integration and SaaS administration, level 3 network management, CI security, and relations with external IT providers. Other team members handle these topics.


    Desired profile

    In general

  • Degree in cybersecurity, information systems or equivalent experience
  • 2 to 5 years of experience in information security, GRC or security operations
  • Based in France

    • Technical skills

  • Practical experience with ISO 27001 (2022): risk analysis, Statement of Applicability, controls, internal or certification audits
  • Knowledge of risk methodologies (ISO 27005, EBIOS RM or similar)
  • Understanding of vulnerability management: CVE, CVSS, SBOM, reading scan and pentest reports
  • Basic knowledge of identity and access management (SSO, SAML/OIDC, MFA, access reviews)
  • Ability to assess the security of a SaaS tool or an application: data flows, permissions, data retention, use of data for AI training
  • Jira (workflows, automation) and spreadsheets for control tracking
  • Python or Bash scripting for automation
  • Clear writing for policies, procedures and answers to customers

    • Bonus skills

  • ISO 42001, EU AI Act or AI risk management (e.g. ISO 23894)
  • EU Cyber Resilience Act, NIS2, CISA Secure by Design, UK Cyber Essentials
  • GDPR and personal data inventories
  • DLP, SIEM, centralized logging and monitoring
  • Linux, cloud (AWS, GCP, Azure), Terraform, Packer, SaltStack
  • Experience in a software vendor and with enterprise customers' security audits

    • Personal skills

  • Organized and rigorous: you run many topics in parallel and follow each one to closure
  • Autonomous and proactive: you follow up with other teams without waiting to be asked
  • Good communicator, able to explain security requirements to non-experts and convince them
  • Curious, eager to learn new norms and regulations as they come out
  • Willing to share knowledge and guide interns

    • Languages

  • Fluent French (the team is based in France)
  • Professional English: daily work with US teams; all policies, documentation and many customer questionnaires are in English

    • Our tools

    GRC platform (OverSecur), Jira and Confluence, OneLogin SSO, Google Workspace, Slack, Salesforce, BambooHR, phishing simulation and awareness platform, internal CVE/SBOM platform, Grafana, vSphere, Terraform, Packer, SaltStack, Python and Bash.

data.title: Stage - Chargé(e) de missions IA
data.description:
SOGECLAIR Training & Simulation conçoit des simulateurs de formation à la conduite ferroviaire, logiciels et matériels, autour de sa plateforme OkSyGen. La société compte environ 125 personnes réparties dans cinq pays : France, Inde, Australie, Canada et Royaume-Uni.

Elle est engagée dans un programme de transformation, qui touche ses métiers, ses méthodes et ses outils. L'IA en est l'un des leviers. Des outils sont déjà déployés et l'équipe de transformation digitale du groupe SOGECLAIR travaille sur le sujet.

Ce que nous recherchons, c'est une personne qui fasse le lien entre ces possibilités et le quotidien des équipes : comprendre les besoins réels, prouver la valeur par des cas concrets, et donner envie à chacun de s'en emparer.

MISSIONS :

Votre rôle : être le catalyseur de l'adoption de l'IA dans toute la société. Vous travaillerez en lien étroit avec l'équipe de transformation digitale du groupe.

  1. Comprendre le terrain. Mener des entretiens dans toutes les équipes (ingénierie, projets, commerce, support client, etc..) pour identifier les irritants réels et les cas d'usage à fort potentiel.
  1. Poser un cadre. Cartographier les données par niveau de sensibilité et proposer des règles d'usage claires : quel outil pour quelle donnée.
  1. Prouver par l'exemple. Concevoir et déployer des POC sur les cas d'usage prioritaires, définir les indicateurs de gain et les mesurer.
  2. Embarquer les équipes. Rendre l'IA compréhensible et utile pour chacun : démonstrations sur le travail réel des équipes, ateliers, formations.
  1. Construire la feuille de route. Élaborer une feuille de route IA couvrant toutes les équipes et la présenter au CODIR.

En 6 mois : une feuille de route IA pour toutes les équipes, des POC déployés et utilisés, et un CODIR qui maîtrise réellement les possibilités de l'IA.

  1. Mois 1 : immersion et diagnostic. Entretiens dans toutes les équipes, cartographie des cas d'usage et des données, cadre d'usage proposé, indicateurs de gain définis et situation de départ mesurée.
  2. Mois 2 à 4 : preuves de valeur. POC déployés sur les cas d'usage prioritaires, premiers gains mesurés, premiers référents IA formés, session de sensibilisation du CODIR.
  3. Mois 5 et 6 : passage à l'échelle. Feuille de route IA présentée au CODIR, kit de réplication pour les sites à l'international, documentation pour assurer la continuité après le stage.

Requirements

Vous êtes en dernière année d'école d'ingénieurs, idéalement avec une double compétence management, et vous avez déjà construit des choses avec l'IA générative.

  • Formation : école d'ingénieurs (option data, IA ou informatique), ou double diplôme ingénieur et manager.
  • Pratique de l'IA : vous avez déjà créé des assistants, des automatisations ou des agents (projet personnel, hackathon, stage), au-delà d'un cours. Vous savez prototyper vite.
  • Pédagogie : vous savez expliquer simplement et donner envie, y compris à des personnes éloignées du sujet.
  • Écoute : vous êtes à l'aise pour mener des entretiens et comprendre un métier qui n'est pas le vôtre.
  • Autonomie et sens politique : vous savez prioriser, avancer seul(e) et embarquer des interlocuteurs de tous niveaux.
  • Anglais courant : la réplication se fera avec des équipes en Inde, en Australie, au Canada et au Royaume-Uni.

 

Benefits

Ce que nous offrons

Un stage où vous verrez la transformation d'une société de l'intérieur, avec les moyens de la faire avancer.

  • Un accès direct à la direction : rattachement au Vice-Président, plusieurs points par semaine, présence aux temps forts du CODIR, accès aux directeurs selon les sujets.
  • De l'impact réel : vos POC seront déployés et utilisés par les équipes, pas rangés dans un rapport.
  • Des moyens : un budget pour les outils et les POC dès le départ, élargi à mesure que les gains sont démontrés.
  • Un terrain de jeu rare : la simulation 3D temps réel, le ferroviaire, une société internationale de taille humaine en pleine transformation.

Le Groupe SOGECLAIR est convaincu que la diversité et l’inclusion sont des éléments essentiels de sa performance et s’engage à recruter sans discrimination.
Dans un souci de lisibilité, le masculin est utilisé dans cette annonce, mais nous encourageons les candidatures de toutes les personnes, sans distinction de genre, d’origine, de handicap ou de toute autre caractéristique.

Work @Sogeclair ✨ :

    • Un environnement de travail international et multiculturel 🌎
    • Des perspectives de mobilité interne
    • Un apprentissage permanent : Sogeclair Academy 🎓
    • Un package de rémunération : RTT, mutuelle, pack mobilité durable, politique cooptation, TR etc.

En savoir plus sur nous 💠 :

  • SOGECLAIR, fort de plus de 60 ans d'expertise, est un fournisseur de solutions innovantes pour une mobilité plus sobre et plus sûre. Présent à l'international, SOGECLAIR a étendu son influence au-delà des frontières, renforçant ainsi sa capacité à innover et à collaborer avec des partenaires du monde entier
  • Nos valeurs :
    • Confiance et esprit d'équipe 💙

data.description:
Description du poste

Le RSSI Groupe aura pour mission de définir, piloter et contrôler la stratégie de cybersécurité du Groupe, avec quatre objectifs principaux :

  1. Réduire l'exposition du Groupe aux risques cyber susceptibles d'affecter ses activités, ses données, ses clients ou son image.
  2. Travailler en collaboration avec la DSI, s’assurer que les bonnes pratiques au niveau du SI soient mises en place.
  3. Garantir notre capacité à répondre aux exigences réglementaires, contractuelles et clients en matière de sécurité.
  4. Structurer la préparation et le suivi des audits, en assurant la mise en œuvre et la clôture des plans d'actions associés.
  5. Donner à la Direction une vision consolidée du niveau de risque cyber, des priorités et des actions engagées.

 

Vos principales missions

Le RSSI Groupe aura notamment la responsabilité de :

    • Définir la stratégie et la feuille de route cybersécurité Groupe ;
    • Identifier et évaluer les principaux risques cyber auxquels le Groupe est exposé ;
    • Proposer à la Direction les priorités et investissements nécessaires à leur maîtrise ;
    • Définir les règles et politiques de sécurité applicables au Groupe ;
    • Coordonner les actions cybersécurité entre les différentes entités ;
    • Accompagner les filiales et les projets stratégiques sur les sujets de sécurité ;
    • Piloter la conformité aux différentes exigences applicables au Groupe ;
    • Préparer et coordonner les audits clients, réglementaires et internes ;
    • Piloter les plans de remédiation issus de ces audits ;
    • Structurer la gestion et l'escalade des incidents cyber ;
    • Développer la sensibilisation et la culture cybersécurité auprès des collaborateurs et du management ;
    • Évaluer les risques liés aux fournisseurs et partenaires critiques ;
    • Mettre en place des indicateurs permettant à la Direction de suivre régulièrement le niveau de risque et l'avancement de la feuille de route.

Requirements

Idéalement : 5 à 10 ans d'expérience en cybersécurité, dont une expérience en gouvernance ou management de la sécurité.

Une expérience dans un environnement :

  • Industriel ;
  • Aéronautique ;
  • Défense ;
  • International ;

Compétences

Le candidat devra maîtriser ou connaître :

  • Gouvernance cybersécurité ;
  • Analyse de risques ;
  • Gestion des audits ;
  • Gestion des incidents ;
  • Gestion des vulnérabilités ;
  • IAM ;
  • Sécurité Cloud ;
  • Sécurité des infrastructures ;
  • Gestion des fournisseurs ;
  • Continuité d'activité ;
  • Référentiels de sécurité ;
  • Environnement Microsoft 365 / Azure / Entra ID.
  • Avoir des connaissances sur la sécurité physique (bâtiments, badges…)

Une bonne maîtrise de l'anglais professionnel me paraît également indispensable compte tenu de la dimension Groupe.

Qualités attendues

data.title: Product Marketing Manager
data.description:
Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous!

Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains.

Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times.

To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies.

BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America.

Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard.

About the role

Agentic process automation is a category enterprises are actively budgeting for - and one crowded with claims. As our Product Marketing Manager, you make sure blp's story cuts through; sharp positioning against the alternatives our buyers actually consider, messaging that speaks to CFOs and COOs in business outcomes rather than technology, and sales teams equipped to win against ERP workflow add-ons, RPA vendors, and point-AI copilots.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role at the center of how blp goes to market. You will own the translation layer between product capability and buyer value - across launches, enablement, competitive intelligence, and the content that carries our positioning into every deal.

 

What you'll do

  • Own positioning and messaging execution. Maintain and evolve blp's messaging house: value proposition, pillars, proof points, and persona-specific narratives, and enforce its consistent use across web, decks, campaigns, and sales conversations.

  • Build and maintain competitive intelligence. Own battlecards and competitive positioning against ERP workflow automation, RPA, IDP/point-AI solutions, and adjacent AI platforms; keep sales ahead of competitor moves and objection patterns.

  • Enable the field. Create and maintain the core sales toolkit - first-meeting decks, discovery guides, objection handling, ROI narratives, and persona playbooks for CFO, COO, shared services, and process excellence audiences.

  • Sharpen personas and ICP. Continuously refine our understanding of buying committees, triggers (ERP transformation, e-invoicing mandates, shared-services efficiency programs), and where we win and lose - grounded in win/loss analysis and field feedback.

  • Drive product launches and releases. Turn platform capabilities and new workflow coverage into launch narratives, internal enablement, and external announcements that land with executive buyers.

  • Fuel demand and thought leadership. Supply campaigns, events, and content marketing with differentiated angles, from executive-facing reports to industry-specific value narratives.

  • Be the voice of the market internally. Bring buyer, analyst, and competitive insight back into product and leadership discussions, even when it complicates the roadmap story, to sharpen framing and packaging.

 

What you'll bring

  • 5–8 years in B2B software marketing, with at least 3 years in product marketing for enterprise SaaS - ideally in ERP-adjacent, finance operations, automation, or applied-AI categories.

  • Proven ability to market to economic buyers: you write for CFOs, CIOs/CTOs, and COOs in the language of cost, productivity, working capital, and EBIT - not features.

  • Strong competitive instincts: experience building battlecards and positioning in crowded categories, and translating technical differentiation into commercial arguments.

  • A portfolio of enablement assets that sales teams actually used - you measure your work by win rates and message adoption, not asset counts.

  • Analytical rigor: comfortable with win/loss analysis, market and analyst research, and grounding messaging claims in defensible evidence.

  • Excellent writing and presentation craft in English; German is a strong plus for our DACH-concentrated customer base.

  • Enough technical depth to understand ERP processes, AI agents, and enterprise integration well enough to challenge product - and simplify it for buyers.

 

What you'll get

  • Category-defining work. Agentic process automation is being defined now, and you will shape how the market understands it.

  • Real substance. 550+ enterprise customers and measurable outcomes mean your positioning rests on proof, not promises.

  • Scope and access. You get a seat at the table with product, sales leadership, and the executive team, and your work goes straight into deals and board narratives.

  • A company at an inflection point. It has a strong European base, fresh US market entry, and a proven platform to build the story on.

 

Learn more about blp and our values at blp.digital/company/careers.

data.title: Senior Mechanical Engineer
data.description:
Join the Wingtra team and become part of this venture-backed robotics scaleup with a global and international team of 125+ dedicated Wingtranauts who want to see their actions have a positive and lasting impact on the world. Founded more than 8 years ago at ETH Zurich, Europe’s leading robotics university, our goal is to build the best aerial robots to digitize the world at the push of a button and set the basis for faster and better decisions. Wingtra provides efficient and reliable data solutions to a variety of industries ranging from mining, construction and agriculture to humanitarian organizations, environmentalists and wildlife monitoring groups.

We are reaching for the stars and together we might just get there. Open communication, asking hard questions and valuing diverse viewpoints are but a few things that will help us achieve our goals. Above all we will never stop learning and striving to help each other reach our maximum potential.

Help us take Wingtra’s new product platforms from fast prototypes to reliable series production. Embedded in the engineering team, you own mechanical design, qualification and industrialization through initial ramp-up. Together we deliver a qualified product, a complete product file and a working production line. We are early adopters of AI and actively build agentic workflows across engineering, from design and test planning to execution and analysis.

Responsibilities

  • Take a new aircraft from concept to series production. You work in a small team with electronics designers and test engineers. You get direct feedback from prototypes, flight tests and production builds.

  • Design and iterate lightweight parts. You design, build and test parts and assemblies, then improve them until they are ready for production.

  • Choose materials and processes with care. You balance performance, volumes, unit cost, tooling investment and lead times.

  • Own DFX. You design for manufacturing, assembly, quality, cost and serviceability, and you settle tolerances, interfaces and process constraints early.

  • Work hand in hand with suppliers. You partner with sourcing on technical feasibility, tooling and part iterations.

  • Own qualification. You qualify parts with the intended production materials and processes, and you agree product-specific acceptance criteria with the test engineers.

  • Deliver the production-ready product file. CAD, 2D drawings, tolerances, BOMs, material and process specifications and acceptance criteria.

  • Hand over a running line. Once the qualification gates have passed and ramp-up is complete, you hand the line and the product file to Production and Production Engineering.


    • Requirements

  • You have several years of experience taking mechanical products through the full lifecycle: prototype, series production and quality monitoring at the customer. Ideally on structurally critical products at volumes of hundreds to a few thousand units.

  • You are strong in CAD (Solidworks/PDM preferred), tolerance analysis and material selection.

  • You have practical experience with injection molding as well as additive manufacturing for functional plastic parts.

  • You prototype fast and pragmatically, then qualify and document with discipline.

  • You like hands-on work: builds, testing and working with suppliers.

  • You use AI for design exploration, qualification planning and data analysis. You check its output, share new workflows and keep raising the team’s bar.

  • You are curious, flexible and collaborative, with a real drive to build the next great thing.

    • If you enjoy teamwork more than being the individual superhero, and if you thrive in a feedback-driven culture and an exciting, unconventional yet structured and progressive start-up environment, we would love to hear from you.

data.title: Applied ML Engineer/Data Scientist
data.description:
🍇 About grape: 
 
Our entrepreneurial spirit drives us in what we do and what we are passionate about. Our mission is to become the premier health partner in the insurance business. Recognising the need for innovation in the traditional employee insurance model we are set to revolutionize the employee insurance industry. We help companies support people before and after they get sick and to make more of their time. Our insurance solutions reduce monotonous and manual work for employees, doctors, HR & payroll managers. As we strive to lead a technology-driven transformation, we put employees first.
 
At grape we pride ourselves on our people and our culture. We continue to grow fast and that’s where you come in. Our team is dynamic, diverse and full of creative ideas. Want to join? We can’t wait to get to know you!

Your role

Our data and tech give us an edge in risk assessment, pricing and premium calculation. This role turns that into accurate models that support our carrier partners and our growth, builds tuned models where they beat rules and off-the-shelf LLMs in claims (triage, intervention, return-to-work, fraud), and responsibly explores how data can help employees stay healthy through grape Care.

We’re looking for an applied ML engineer / data scientist to build predictive models from the ground up on real, regulated insurance data. You’ll own problems end to end, from effective-dated records to production, in a domain where correctness and responsible use genuinely matter.

Starting points include pricing and risk, portfolio monitoring, claims and payment patterns, triage and return-to-work, absence, and fraud detection. grape sits on a rich dataset, though, and you’ll help find the next high-value use cases. You’re candid about what the data can support, and you propose simpler approaches when they’re the right answer.

This is not an LLM role. LLM and agent workflows and document extraction sit with our engineering teams, and you’ll use their outputs as features.


What you'll do:

Build and validate models

  • Own the full model lifecycle: feature engineering, training, evaluation, explainability, deployment, and drift monitoring.

  • Produce audit-ready validation and governance documentation that actuarial, compliance, and carrier partners can review.

    • Platform and MLOps

  • Deploy models on grape’s cloud platform within strict security and data-residency requirements for health data.

  • Identify and prioritize high-value use cases as you explore the dataset, rather than waiting to be handed problems.

data.title: Sales Manager CH, KI-Software für Psychotherapeut:innen
data.description:
Über VIA HealthTech

VIA macht aus einer Therapiesitzung ein fertiges Sitzungsprotokoll und aus Sitzungsprotokollen vollständige psychologische Berichte. Arbeit, die Therapeut:innen bisher mehrere Stunden pro Woche gekostet hat.

Wir sind die marktführende KI-Assistenz für Psychotherapeut:innen. Über 4.000 Psychotherapeut:innen im DACH-Raum nutzen VIA, wir verarbeiten Hunderttausende Sitzungen pro Monat. Wir sind nach ISO 27001:2022 zertifiziert und verfügen über ein BSI-C5-Testat.

Wir sind ein multidisziplinäres Team in Berlin-Mitte. Marktführer in Deutschland zu sein, ist erst der Startpunkt. Die Schweiz ist unser nächster Markt, und du baust ihn mit auf.

Die Rolle

Du bist unsere erste Person im Schweizer Markt. Du baust die Pipeline von Grund auf, entwickelst das Playbook und führst es selbst aus.

In Deutschland läuft unser Funnel vor allem über Webinare: Therapeut:innen melden sich an, testen VIA 14 Tage und buchen selbst. Du findest heraus, was davon in der Schweiz funktioniert und was anders laufen muss: Qualifizierung am Telefon, Cold-Calling, andere Outbound- und Inbound-Kanäle, Verbände, Weiterbildungsinstitute, grössere Organisationen als eigener Kanal. Du testest, misst und skalierst, wo der Hebel am grössten ist.

Du arbeitest eng mit Marketing an Zielgruppen, Kampagnen und Botschaften für den Schweizer Markt und gibst direkt zurück, was im Gespräch wirklich zieht.

Die Rolle ist senior gedacht. Wenn du mid-level, aber aussergewöhnlich schnell und hungrig bist, bewirb dich trotzdem.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Den Markt öffnen. Du identifizierst die wichtigsten Zielgruppen in der Schweiz: selbstständige psychologische Psychotherapeut:innen, Psychiater:innen, Organisationen der psychologischen Psychotherapie, Ambulatorien und Kliniken. Du priorisierst, wo wir zuerst gewinnen.
  • Leads in Kund:innen verwandeln. Qualifizierungsgespräche, Webinare, Demos, Follow-up während der Testphase, Abschluss. Du bist die zentrale Ansprechperson für Schweizer Kund:innen.
  • Neue Kanäle erschliessen. Berufsverbände wie FSP, ASP und SBAP, Weiterbildungsinstitute, Fachveranstaltungen und Kongresse. Erstansprache per Telefon, E-Mail und LinkedIn, wo sie sich lohnt.
  • Playbook bauen, während du verkaufst. Was konvertiert, welche Einwände in der Schweiz wirklich kommen (etwa zu Datenschutz und Datenhaltung), welche Sequenz funktioniert.
  • Zahlen verantworten. Deine KPIs entlang des Funnels, gemeinsam mit unserem Commercial Engine Lead, der Tracking und Infrastruktur baut.
  • Sales-Enablement-Material. Du passt an, was zum Verkaufen und Vermarkten in der Schweiz am besten wirkt, von Sprache bis Preisdarstellung in CHF.
  • Feedback ins Produkt bringen. Was Schweizer Kund:innen brauchen und woran Deals scheitern, besprichst du direkt mit dem Produktteam.

Dein Profil

Must-have

  • Nachgewiesene Abschlüsse im B2B-Vertrieb in der Schweiz, idealerweise SaaS oder Digital Health, belegbar in Zahlen
  • Echte Hunter-Mentalität. Du hast bereits aktiv Erstkontakte am Telefon gemacht und hast damit kein Problem. Wenn dich 40 Gespräche am Tag abschrecken, ist das die falsche Rolle
  • Kenntnis des Schweizer Gesundheitswesens oder die Fähigkeit, dich sehr schnell einzuarbeiten: Grundversicherung, Anordnungsmodell, Rolle von Kantonen und Verbänden
  • Glaubwürdigkeit gegenüber Therapeut:innen. Psychotherapeut:innen vertrauen vor allem Psychotherapeut:innen. Entweder bringst du diesen Hintergrund mit, oder du arbeitest dich so schnell und so tief ein, dass man es dir im Gespräch nicht anmerkt
  • Systemdenken. Du baust reproduzierbare Prozesse statt Einzelfälle, mit dem Ziel, dass dein Ansatz auch ohne dich funktioniert
  • Hunger und unternehmerischer Ehrgeiz. Du willst einen neuen Markt aufbauen, nicht eine Quote abarbeiten
  • Kommunikationsstärke mit Abschlussfokus. Empathisch und auf Augenhöhe, denn Psychotherapeut:innen merken sofort, wenn jemand verkauft, statt zu verstehen
  • Selbstständige, strukturierte und datengetriebene Arbeitsweise, auch remote und ohne Team vor Ort, sowie sicherer Umgang mit CRM-Systemen
  • Deutsch auf verhandlungssicherem Niveau (C2), auch Schweizerdeutsch, gutes Englisch
  • Verfügbarkeit am frühen Abend. Unsere Zielgruppe ist häufig erst nach der letzten Sitzung erreichbar, Termine zwischen 17 und 19 Uhr gehören dazu. Im Gegenzug gestaltest du deinen Tag frei

Von Vorteil

  • Französisch und/oder Italienisch, um später auch die weiteren Gebiete anzusprechen
  • Ein bestehendes Netzwerk in der Schweizer Psychotherapie- oder Psychiatrieszene
  • Erfahrung mit Funnels, in denen Marketing und Vertrieb ineinandergreifen: Performance-Marketing, Webinare, Trials, Self-Service
  • Anerkennung als Psychotherapeut:in, psychologische Ausbildung oder mehrjährige Erfahrung im Gesundheitswesen
  • Vertriebserfahrung mit Praxen, Heilberufen oder Spitälern in der Schweiz
  • Hands-on-Erfahrung mit Sales-Automation, LinkedIn Sales Navigator oder Outbound-Tooling
  • Erfahrung im Markteintritt oder Aufbau eines Vertriebs von 0 auf 1

Diese Rolle ist nichts für dich, wenn

  • Du ein Team suchst, das für dich telefoniert.
  • Du eine fertige Pipeline oder ein bestehendes Länderteam erwartest. Du baust beides.
  • Du weder Hunger noch besonderen Ehrgeiz mitbringst. Wir sind ein ambitioniertes Team und stellen entsprechend ein.

Was wir bieten

  • Einen Markt, den du prägst. Du bist die erste Person von VIA in der Schweiz. Was du aufbaust, wird zum Fundament unseres Schweizer Geschäfts
  • Ein Team, das überperformt. DACH-Marktführer für KI-Assistenz in der Psychotherapie in zwei Jahren, bootstrapped. Unsere Pläne von hier sind deutlich grösser, und wir stellen Menschen ein, die das mitgestalten wollen
  • Hohe Autonomie und Erfolgsbeteiligung. Bei uns zählen Kompetenz und Umsetzung. Wir legen dir keine Steine in den Weg, und du verdienst an dem, was du aufbaust
  • Attraktives Paket. Wettbewerbsfähiges Fixum in CHF plus ungedeckelte Provision, dazu Beteiligung am Unternehmen
  • Direkter Draht. Du arbeitest täglich mit den Gründern und dem multidisziplinären Team, Entscheidungen fallen in Stunden statt in Wochen
  • Sinnstiftende Arbeit. Jede Praxis, die du gewinnst, bedeutet mehrere Stunden pro Woche, die wieder Patient:innen zugutekommen
  • Flexibel arbeiten. Remote aus der Schweiz, freie Zeiteinteilung, moderne Ausstattung und regelmässige Teamtage in unserem Büro in Berlin-Mitte

Wir suchen keine:n klassische:n Vertriebler:in, sondern eine:n Macher:in, die oder der mit Hunger und Hands-on-Mentalität VIA in der Schweiz zur ersten Wahl macht.

data.title: Senior Backend & AI Engineer (Remote)
data.description:
This role is open only to candidates living in the EU or EEA. We can't consider applications from other locations.

If you've built something before, start here

The hardest part of a startup usually isn't the code. It's finding customers who really need what you build and getting them to change how they work. At Scalera, that part is done: manufacturers, suppliers and contractors across Switzerland, Austria and Germany already run their tenders through us every day.

What we need now are people who can take the next unsolved problem and turn it into a product customers can't do without. If you've founded a company (whether it worked out or not), been the first engineer somewhere, or built something people paid for, this role was written for you.

About Scalera

Scalera is an ETH Zurich spin-off building AI for the €200B+ European construction industry. Large manufacturers and suppliers still run their most document-heavy processes by hand, from reading 300-page tenders to retyping purchase orders into their ERP. We automate them one by one. Our product matching already handles 1,400 tender positions in 16 minutes at 98% precision, work that used to take a sales rep most of a day.

What you'll do

You'll be part product manager, part engineer. You'll spend real time with customers and help shape what we build. Sometimes you'll spot the next problem yourself, and sometimes we'll hand you a clear priority to run with.

  • Spend real time with customers. Join calls and site visits, sit with the people who do the work, and understand why they do it the way they do. You'll know their problems firsthand, not from a ticket.

  • Shape what to build. Turn what you hear into a clear problem, a scope and a plan, and push back when the obvious request isn't the real need. When we bring you a priority, you'll own how it gets solved.

  • Build it. Design and build backend services in Go and Python that turn messy tenders, catalogs and purchase orders into data customers can rely on.

  • Ship, then check. Get it in front of customers fast, watch how they actually use it, and iterate.

  • Own it in production. When something breaks at a customer, it's yours to understand and fix.

  • Build with AI. Use AI heavily in how you work, and design systems that agents can use as well as people.

What success looks like after 3 months

  • There's a part of the product people now think of as yours, and you're the one deciding what happens to it next

  • You've spotted a problem nobody asked you to solve, made the case for it, and shipped a first version

  • You've shipped features from both sources: priorities we set and ideas from your own customer conversations

  • At least once, you've talked us out of building something customers didn't really need

  • You've left a part of the platform simpler than you found it

You'll probably thrive here if

  • You've taken something from zero to one: a company, a product line, or a side project with paying users

  • You've built and run backend systems in production that other people depend on. We care more about your judgment than your language; you're strong in Go or Python and happy to work in both

  • You're solid on data modeling, API design and messy real-world data

  • You'd rather talk to a customer than wait for a spec

  • You're comfortable with ambiguity. You can make progress while the problem is still half-defined, which at a startup it usually is

  • You want a large scope of responsibility and are happy to own things well beyond your job title

  • Rapidly changing requirements don't throw you. When customers or priorities shift, you adapt and keep going

  • You enjoy direct customer contact and want to be on customer calls

  • You make things simpler over time, not more clever

  • You write clearly in English. German is a plus, not a requirement

You probably won't enjoy it if

  • You just want to code and go home

  • You don't like talking to customers, whether on calls or on the occasional site visit

  • Ambiguity and chaos bother you

  • You want a well-defined backlog handed to you

  • Your main goal is managing people soon. Here, scope grows with what you own, not with headcount

Our stack

Go and Python (FastAPI), PostgreSQL, GCP, and LLMs throughout the document pipeline. You don't need to know all of it on day one.

How we hire

  1. Screening call (30 min) with our VP Engineering. It's two-way: ask us anything, including the hard questions.

  2. Technical deep-dive call: walk us through something you built from scratch, the decisions you made and what went wrong.

  3. Meet Scalera Day: join us remotely to work on a real problem with real (anonymized) construction documents, and meet the team.

  4. Offer: if it's a fit on both sides, we'll move quickly to an offer.

Working at Scalera

  • Remote within the EU or EEA

  • Small team, no bureaucracy. You'll work directly with the CEO, CTO, VP Engineering and Customer Success

  • Competitive compensation

Founders and former founders: if you're unsure whether you fit, send a few lines about what you built and why you moved on. We read every one.
