data.title: Senior AI/ML Engineer
data.description:
This role is also open to candidates living in the EU or EEA. We can't consider applications from other locations.

If you've built something before, start here

Most ML jobs hand you a benchmark. This one hands you a business problem with paying customers and their real data. Construction tenders are long, messy and full of trade jargon, and every decision a customer makes on our platform becomes a labeled example you can train on.

We need someone who can turn that data into models that customers notice: from the first experiment to the model serving production traffic, and back again when a customer says it got something wrong. If you've founded a company (whether it worked out or not), been the first ML engineer somewhere, or shipped a model people paid for, this role was written for you.

About Scalera

Scalera is an ETH Zurich spin-off building AI for the €200B+ European construction industry. Manufacturers, wholesalers and suppliers in Switzerland, Austria and Germany still run their most document-heavy work by hand, from reading 300-page tenders to retyping purchase orders into their ERP. We automate that work one process at a time, and ML sits at the center of every one of them.

What you'll own

You'll own the ML behind our products, end to end. In practice that means:

  • Training and fine-tuning: embedding models, rerankers, classifiers and LLMs, trained on our own data.

  • Document understanding: models that pull structure, quantities and product specs out of tenders, orders and catalogs.

  • Product matching: retrieval and LLM agents that match tender positions to the right products.

  • Evaluation: offline benchmarks, per-customer evals and gates that keep a new model from shipping if it makes things worse.

  • Training and serving infrastructure: automated retrain pipelines, GPU serving and vector search in production.

  • Customer problems: when a model gets something wrong for a customer, finding out why and fixing it.

What success looks like after 3 months

  • There's a model or part of the pipeline people now think of as yours, and you're the one deciding what happens to it next.

  • You've spotted a problem nobody asked you to solve, made the case for it, and shipped a first version.

  • A model you trained runs in production, and customers can see the difference in their results.

  • Retraining runs automatically, and nothing reaches customers without passing an eval you designed.

  • You've cut LLM cost or latency by replacing an expensive step with a smaller model of your own.

  • You've decided at least one thing we should stop building.

You'll probably thrive here if

  • You've taken something from zero to one: a company, a model in production, or a side project with real users.

  • You've trained and fine-tuned models yourself, ideally embeddings, retrieval or document models, and evaluated them honestly on held-out data.

  • You've built with LLMs in production and know where agents fail.

  • You write strong Python and can run what you build: Docker, CI/CD, and cloud on GCP, AWS or Azure.

  • You measure before you believe, and a single aggregate score doesn't convince you.

  • You'd rather open a customer's actual document than wait for a spec.

  • You're comfortable with ambiguity. You can make progress while the problem is still half-defined, which at a startup it usually is.

  • You want a large scope of responsibility and are happy to own things well beyond your job title.

  • Rapidly changing requirements don't throw you. When customers or priorities shift, you adapt and keep going.

  • You enjoy direct customer contact and want to be on customer calls.

  • You write clearly in English. German is a plus, not a requirement.

You probably won't enjoy it if

  • You just want to code and go home.

  • You don't like talking to customers.

  • Ambiguity and chaos bother you.

  • You want a well-defined research agenda handed to you.

  • You'd rather hand a model to someone else to deploy and debug.

  • Your main goal is managing people soon. Here, scope grows with what you own, not with headcount.

Our stack

Python and PyTorch, open-weight and frontier LLMs, LangGraph, Langfuse, PostgreSQL with pgvector, Pinecone, and GCP. You don't need to know all of it on day one.

How we hire

  1. Screening call (30 min) with our VP Engineering. It's two-way: ask us anything, including the hard questions.

  2. Technical deep-dive call: walk us through a model or system you built, the decisions you made and what went wrong in production.

  3. Meet Scalera Day: come to our office in Zürich, work on a real problem with real (anonymized) tender data, and meet the team.

  4. Offer: if it's a fit on both sides, we'll move quickly to an offer.

Working at Scalera

  • Zürich HQ, four days in the office, Fridays remote. If not located in Zürich then this role is open to remote within the EU or EEA,

  • Occasional customer visits across Switzerland, Austria and Germany

  • Small team, no bureaucracy. You'll work directly with the CEO, CTO, VP Engineering and Customer Success

  • Competitive salary and meaningful equity

Founders and former founders: if you're unsure whether you fit, send a few lines about what you built and why you moved on. We read every one.

data.title: Chief Customer Officer
data.description:
Work from anywhere, impact everywhere 

Diversity is at the heart of who we are at Xapo Bank.
We're a fully distributed team of over 160 Xapiens that work remotely from 50+ countries around the world.

Our beginning: A world that enjoys economic freedom and wealth protection,no matter where you live or who is running your country.
To achieve that, we search the world for the best people for the job.
We work hard, think globally, and inspire each other to learn and grow.
We are committed to changing the way things are done.

Although we are headquartered in Gibraltar, this is a full time, 100% remote position 
Work from anywhere!

Position overview

Xapo's product suite has grown from a Bitcoin vault into a full member proposition: BTC and USD accounts that pay interest, a global card with Bitcoin cashback, Bitcoin-backed loans, a growing suite of BTC wealth and credit products, and access to stocks, ETFs, and stablecoins, all inside one regulated relationship. 

Xapo is a bank, and a bank earns on the money its members choose to hold with it. Each of those products shipped well. What hasn't yet existed is a single owner of the economics of the customer relationship: one person accountable for winning the right members, growing what they hold with us, and keeping them, and for the balance-sheet products that make that possible.

The Chief Customer Officer is a new role at the top of the house, reporting to the CEO. You will run the stream that grows what members hold with Xapo, and you will own the Customer P&L, retail and institutional. It brings growth, client coverage, product management, and product design under one leader who is judged on customer contribution, the assets attracted and kept, and the members who stay. This is a customer-focused role in the most commercial sense: what a member earns from us, not the feature we shipped, is the centre of every decision.

The measure of success is a Customer P&L that grows on what members hold and keep: LTV:CAC improving, approved-to-paid rising, churn falling, and customer contribution the business can plan against.

This is a banking role, not a requirements-gathering role, a marketing role, or a role you can run from a dashboard. Products are priced on the balance sheet and judged on the money they attract and keep.

The mandate

  1. Own the Customer P&L, retail and institutional.
    You own customer contribution: customer gross profit from what members' balances earn, secured lending, Bitcoin yield, and conversion, stocks and ETFs, less the cost of winning and keeping members. We earn on what members hold, not on what they tap, send, or click, so you run on assets held and the margin they earn, not payment volume. Good looks like a Customer P&L the Exco and Board can plan against, where every line has a number you own and can explain, up or down.
  2. Grow what members hold with us, through earning products run like a banker would.
    You own the roadmap for the balance-sheet products: deposits and savings, lending and credit, and trading and structured. Each is led by a mission PM who is a banker, owning a product's contribution and its price on the balance sheet, not a backlog. Requirements go through the gate; the economics are the job. Every item is priced by Finance before it is built, on a shared risk appetite with Risk and Treasury. Good looks like products that scale assets held and member lifetime value at a risk profile the Board actually approved.
  3. Win the right members, efficiently.
    You own Growth: audience, lifecycle, and content, with one head accountable for the path from approval to paid. You own CAC and approved-to-paid, find the members who bring other members, and activate them in week one. Every incentive is priced before it runs. Good looks like net paid-member growth that improves every quarter, at a CAC that LTV comfortably justifies, because you diagnosed where the funnel leaks rather than spending more to fill it.
  4. Keep members, and deepen the relationship with the ones who hold balances.
    Retention is the most efficient growth we have. You own churn, and you own Client Coverage: relationship managers who sell the missions' products to the members who hold balances, and loop demand back into the roadmap. You are accountable for net new AUM flow, covered-book retention, and products per covered member, and for growth that is broad-based rather than concentrated in a few accounts. Good looks like falling churn and AUM growth from members who stay and expand rather than members re-acquired at cost.
  5. Make the value of Xapo visible, and the experience effortless.
    You own Product Design: one design system and one shell, so that members see the value of what they are earning clearly and early, and find every task simple. You design the proposition in the stream with Finance and partner with Operations, who run onboarding, KYC, support, cards, and payments, to remove friction at the points that affect members most. Good looks like members who understand their return, complete what they set out to do, and stay.
  6. Build one Customer organisation, not four.
    Growth, Client Coverage, Mission PMs, and Product Design come together under one operating model: one set of key results read weekly from one source, shared frameworks for discovery and prioritisation, and real career paths for the people in it. Engineering is pulled to a single ranked roadmap, and nobody in your line has engineers of their own. Good looks like fewer hand-offs per outcome and a number for every cell that its owner explains every week.
  7. Bring the regulated-bank and crypto-native lens to every customer call.
    You understand that a KYC onboarding decision and an AML monitoring decision carry different risk appetites, that a false positive at the gate is a paid-for member lost, and that a proposition built for a crypto-native power user can still fail a first-time bank customer. You can sit in the same room as a CRO, an MLRO, a CFO, and an engineering lead and make a customer case that survives all four conversations.

How you'll operate

This part matters as much as the mandate. The known failure mode for this role, in any company, is a CCO with a polished customer-insight deck and no ownership of the number. That is disqualifying here.

  • You lead from inside the work. You sit in on growth reviews, mission PM reviews, client meetings, and member calls, not just steering committees. PMs, designers, and relationship managers three levels down know your name because you've solved problems with them.
  • You move people with the business case, not the whip. When a priority needs to change, you diagnose the problem, build the case with data and the economics, and show teams why it matters, so they re-prioritise because they're convinced, not because they were told. Your authority comes from being right and being useful, not from your title.
  • You have extreme ownership. You own the Customer P&L and the member metrics beneath it, not the feature ship date. If a launch didn't move contribution, LTV:CAC, approved-to-paid, or churn, you don't report "the roadmap item shipped", you change the approach.
  • You have genuine gravitas. Senior, experienced leaders welcome your input because you've earned the standing to give it. You can challenge any executive's plan, including the CEO's, constructively, with evidence, and be thanked for it, because your challenge makes their work stronger.
  • You diagnose before you prescribe. You can walk into a leaking funnel, a churning segment, or a product that isn't earning and find the structural cause, then fix the economics, not just the symptom.

What you'll have done 

  • 10+ years in senior commercial or customer leadership (CCO, Chief Growth or Commercial Officer, MD or Head of Retail or Wealth, or equivalent) in digital banking, fintech, or payments, including meaningful time in a regulated environment (banking licence, e-money, or equivalent prudential/conduct regime).
  • Crypto-native credibility: hands-on experience building and growing customer propositions on or around digital assets, custody, on-chain flows, Bitcoin-backed lending, or similar. You don't need Bitcoin explained to you, and you don't need banking explained to you either.
  • Customer P&L ownership: you have owned a customer or product P&L judged on contribution, balances, and margin rather than transaction volume, and you are fluent in NIM, unit economics, customer contribution, and LTV:CAC.
  • Growth and lifecycle: a track record of acquiring, activating, and retaining members in a regulated, KYC-heavy environment, improving approved-to-paid and churn while holding CAC to a level that LTV justifies, not just growth-hacking a free consumer app.
  • Banking-grade product leadership: you have led product management for balance-sheet products such as savings, lending, or structured products, priced with Finance, with PMs who own a product's economics rather than a backlog. Experience with client coverage or relationship-managed models for high-balance and institutional clients is a strong advantage.
  • Commercial and risk fluency: you can build a customer business case that survives scrutiny from Finance, Risk, and Compliance in the same meeting, and you know the difference between growth that's sustainable and growth that's borrowed from tomorrow's risk appetite.
  • A track record of outcomes you can narrate: specific LTV:CAC, approved-to-paid, churn, AUM, or contribution numbers you owned, bets you killed when the data didn't support them, and outcomes you can prove.

 

The first 90 days

Day 30: The Customer P&L baseline is documented across retail and institutional: customer contribution, LTV:CAC, approved-to-paid, churn, net paid-member growth, and assets attracted and kept. You have formed your own independent view of where members are won, lost, and under-served, and shared it with the CEO and Board.
Day 60: The unified Customer operating model is live: one set of key results across Growth, Client Coverage, Mission PMs, and Product Design, read weekly from one source. Every mission PM owns a product's contribution and its price, and the roadmap is ranked on what it earns, built with Finance and the line leads.
Day 90: At least one measurable improvement in LTV:CAC, approved-to-paid, churn, or net new AUM flow is live and attributable to a change you made, not a feature ship, an outcome moved. Every cell in your line has defined key results and an owner who explains the number every week.

What this role is not

  • Not a requirements-gathering role. Mission PMs are bankers who own a product's contribution and price, not a backlog. You partner with Technology, Finance, and Operations on execution; you don't run those functions.
  • Not a volume role. If your primary output is card spend, transfer volume, or a shipped list rather than assets held and the margin they earn, we have both failed.
  • Not a reporting layer. If your primary output is a customer-insight deck or a roadmap deck, we have both failed.
  • Not a role that can be done from a distance. Remote-first means distributed, not detached.

Other requirements

  • A dedicated workspace.
  • A reliable internet connection with the fastest speed possible in your area.
  • Alignment with Our Values and the Xapo Values-Driven Leadership principles.

Why work for Xapo?

Impact Globally, Work Remotely.

  • Shape the Future
    Improve lives through cutting-edge technology, work 100% remotely from anywhere in the world.

  • Great work-life balance
    Build amazing things with a balance of autonomy and collaborative teamwork. Set your own work schedule and make use of a flexible PTO plan when you need to recharge. 

  • Expect Excellence
    Collaborate, learn, and grow with a high-performance team. Learn how you learn best - from books to conferences, you'll get a yearly budget for your individual learning and development goals.

At Xapo, we prioritize consumer protection and adhere to regulatory requirements by ensuring that all Xapiens are accountable for upholding principles of fair treatment, transparency, and ethical conduct in their interactions with customers and stakeholders.

data.title: Homologation & Certification Engineer, Energy Systems
data.description:
About EH Energy Engineering

EH Energy is developing cutting-edge fuel cell technology for heavy-duty mobility and large-scale stationary power applications. Our uniquely redesigned product delivers a significantly more compact fuel cell system with high power density and lower production costs. In response to the challenges of climate change and the global shift toward decentralized energy, EH Energy provides high-performance, cost-effective fuel cell solutions to our clients and partners.

To support our rapid growth and bring our systems to global markets, we are seeking a Certification Engineer. In this critical role, you will take full ownership of our product compliance roadmap, bridging the gap between innovative engineering and strict global regulations. You will lead hazard and risk assessments, define certification strategies across international markets (EU, North America, marine), and interface directly with notified bodies and classification societies to ensure our fuel cell systems are safe, fully compliant, and market-ready.

This role requires a full-time, on-site presence at our office in Nyon, Switzerland. We are unable to offer remote or hybrid arrangements, so candidates should be based locally or prepared to relocate.

 

Key responsibilities

Certification strategy and project management

  • Identify applicable directives, regulations, harmonised standards and class rules early in the development cycle and translate them into design requirements (EU, North America, marine)

  • Select and manage notified bodies, NRTLs, classification societies and test laboratories, own budgets, schedules and contracts for certification work

  • Plan and witness type tests, factory acceptance tests (FAT) and site acceptance tests (SAT)

Safety engineering and risk analysis

  • Lead risk assessments to ISO 12100 and hazard studies (HAZID, HAZOP to IEC 61882)

  • Lead design and process FMEA (IEC 60812) for stacks, balance of plant, containers and fuel processing

  • Run explosion-protection assessments: hazardous area classification (IEC 60079-10-1), ventilation and gas detection concepts, and equipment selection

  • Specify and verify safety functions to ISO 13849 (PL) and IEC 61508, including safety requirement specifications and validation reports

Compliance and technical documentation

  • Compile and maintain technical construction files, CE Declarations of Conformity, type-approval dossiers and certification reports

  • Write and review user, installation, operation and maintenance manuals, safety instructions and labelling

  • Maintain the standards register and assess the impact of new or revised standards

  • Manage certification change control: assess design changes for impact on existing certificates

Collaboration and continuous improvement

  • Act as the internal authority on certification scope: ensure in-service conformity of series production with certified designs, and support procurement and supply chain on material and packaging compliance (e.g. RoHS, packaging regulations).

  • Support design reviews and supplier qualification, including component certificates (ATEX, PED, electrical)

Standards and regulatory scope

The role covers, but is not limited to, the frameworks below. Working knowledge of most is expected; deep expertise in several is required

  • IEC 62282 series, CSA/ANSI FC 1:2021, ISO 16110-1 and Machinery Regulation (EU) 2023/1230

     

Required qualifications

  • Master’s or bachelor’s degree in mechanical, electrical, chemical, process or safety engineering, or equivalent

  • 5+ years in product certification, compliance or safety engineering for complex electromechanical or process equipment (energy, gas, process, machinery or marine)

  • Direct experience with hydrogen or fuel cell systems and the IEC 62282 series, CSA/ANSI FC 1 or ISO 16110

  • Proven track record of taking products through CE marking and third-party certification with notified bodies or NRTLs

  • Hands-on experience leading FMEA, HAZOP and risk assessments, and documenting them to auditor standard

  • Solid knowledge of ATEX / IECEx, hazardous area classification and explosion-protection concepts

  • Experience specifying and validating safety functions to ISO 13849 and/or IEC 61508

  • Excellent technical writing: clear, structured, audit-ready technical files and manuals

  • Fluent English, written and spoken

     

Preferred qualifications and personal profile

Nice to have

  • Marine type approval with a classification society (DNV, LR, BV, ABS) or IGF Code projects

  • Experience with fuel processing, reformers or fire equipment, and with pressure equipment under PED

  • Certified functional safety qualification or ATEX/IECEx competence certification

  • Familiarity with North American codes (NEC, NFPA) and UL/CSA certification

Personal profile

  • Rigorous and structured, with a strong safety mindset and an eye for detail

  • Pragmatic: finds compliant solutions that keep development moving

  • Confident communicator with engineers, auditors, authorities and customers

  • Self-driven in a fast-growing, scale-up environment; comfortable owning topics end to end

     

Start date: Immediately

data.title: Mandatory Internship Overall Aircraft Design (all genders)
data.description:
Your Mission:

Be part of aviation history at VÆRIDION, where we’re pioneering the world’s first electric nine-seater aircraft! As an Overall Aircraft Design Intern (all genders), you will join our Central Engineering team and support across various Overall Aircraft Design activities. This role is a broad role, and you will perform different tasks to support on-going aircraft design and analysis activities. You will be part of our interdisciplinary aircraft design team and contribute directly to the design process of our battery-electric aircraft.

 

Your Day-to-Day:

  • Support the analysis and comparison of battery-electric aircraft concepts across different configurations and mission profiles.

  • Investigate how technology assumptions and key design parameters influence aircraft performance, energy demand, and overall feasibility.

  • Develop and adapt computational tools to support aircraft sizing, mission analysis, and design trade-off studies.

  • Perform parameter and sensitivity studies to explore design dependencies and identify key technology drivers.

  • Collect, assess, and organise technical data to support consistent modelling assumptions and comparative analyses.

  • Document methods, assumptions, and results, and prepare clear visualisations to discuss findings with the engineering team.

Your Profile:

  • Currently enrolled in a Master’s degree programme in Aerospace Engineering or a comparable technical discipline.

  • Holding a Bachelor’s degree in Aerospace Engineering or a comparable technical discipline.

  • Excellent programming skills (e.g., Python, MATLAB).

  • Experience with aircraft design process, methods and tools. Experience with dedicated tools such as OpenMDAO and Aviary is a strong plus.

  • Readily available knowledge about aircraft.

  • Structured, analytical, and solution-oriented professional with strong ownership, facilitation, and stakeholder-management skills.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; additional European languages are an asset, combined with a strong motivation for aviation and electric aircraft technologies.

We recognize that women and other under-represented groups are often overlooked in our industry. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every listed qualification, we still encourage you to apply. Talent and potential can’t always be captured in a checklist.

 

Why us?

  • Be part of an ambitious team determined to shape the future of aviation.

  • We are an in-office company, but we value flexibility and trust employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work or adjusting hours to accommodate personal commitments.

  • Subsidized EGYM Wellpass membership: your (mental) health is important for us.

  • Become a part of our success with virtual stock options.

  • Choose the option that suits your needs: either a free charging station for your electric car or a public transport job ticket as part of the Deutschlandticket.

  • Lease a high-quality bicycle or e-bike through our JobRad program and benefit from tax advantages. Whether for your daily commute or personal use, enjoy more mobility and sustainability.

  • Pension scheme to support your long-term financial security.

  • Work in one of our offices in Munich or Delft. Enjoy the modern Balan Campus in Munich or work close to the innovative Aerospace TU Delft.

  • Boost your professional as well as personal growth executing your own ideas and independent projects.

  • Join our internal social events and retreats (e.g. cooking, game nights, sports).

VÆRIDION was founded in 2021 to transform regional air travel with the Microliner, a 100% electric commercial aircraft. By delivering the most energy-efficient aircraft, we are building the future where clean, safe, and affordable electric aviation seamlessly connects people and businesses. We’re bringing together the brightest minds in aerospace, automotive engineering, and business to disrupt the aviation industry.

Director Go-to-Market and Revenue Strategy
data.description:
Who We Are

You've ordered dinner through Just Eat Takeaway. You've bought and sold on OLX. You've paid with PayU. Chances are, you've already used a Prosus company today.

We are Prosus, a global technology company powering some of the world's leading lifestyle ecommerce businesses. Every day, billions of people across India, Latin America, Europe and beyond use our products and services to buy, sell, pay, connect and discover.

Our AI-driven ecosystem spans 100+ companies across ecommerce, food delivery, fintech and experiences, serving billions of consumers worldwide. AI powers how we operate and innovate, with more than 60,000 active AI agents helping our teams build, scale and move faster. Through our investment team, we also back the founders and technologies shaping the future: From robotics and autonomous systems to synthetic biology and frontier AI.

Guided by our five values Innovation, Results, People, Impact, and Entrepreneurship, culture is our competitive advantage. We thrive with experimentation; we build, we test, we learn, we iterate.

Join us in shaping the future of technology at global scale.

WHO YOU ARE

You are a commercial leader who has built the go-to-market of a platform from a blank page and knows what it takes to turn a product that people already use into a business that pays for itself. You have priced and packaged products for marketplaces, brands or merchants, and you have seen the difference between a model that looks good in a spreadsheet and one that a small business owner actually adopts.

You are comfortable in a B2B2C world: the customer is reached through someone else's channel, the data belongs to the ecosystem, and the money comes from several ends of a transaction at once. You influence without authority, because the teams that execute will rarely report to you. You are rigorous with numbers and plain with people, and you are at ease saying what the evidence shows even when the room expects something else.

You want to build something that reaches millions of small businesses, you are prepared to work for it.

THE OPPORTUNITY

Toqan for Partners is the AI assistant for the merchants across the companies of the Prosus ecosystem: restaurants, pharmacies, hotels, sellers, real estate agencies and car dealers, five million businesses in total. It launched to restaurants on iFood in Brazil in September 2026 and reached 65,000 restaurants in four weeks with no media spend.

The next twelve months decide how it will become a business: which applications partners pay for and at what price, how value is shared with everyone the partner transacts with, how the uplift is measured and published so the next company embeds, and how the product travels from iFood to the rest of the ecosystem and to India and Europe. You will lead that work, as the owner of the go-to-market and the revenue strategy of Toqan for Partners, alongside the product and technology leads who own what gets built.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Own the commercial model

Define pricing and packaging for the applications partners pay for, media management, supply, finance and operations, at a fraction of what they spend today and justified by the return they see. Design how Toqan takes part in the value it creates for the other end: take rate on agent-negotiated supply, credit origination, brand and industry media, and cross-sell of the ecosystem companies' own products. Set the rules that keep it honest, starting with the separation between paid placement and recommendation.

Drive the rollout across the ecosystem

With the Head of Operations, secure the commitment of each business in the ecosystem: sponsor, distribution, conditional yes and first market. Run the rollout inside each one, working through the teams that own the merchant relationship, and bring the product to its next verticals and markets.

Build the measurement

Own the scoreboard: active partners under a strict definition, uplift per business in retention and GMV, cost and value per active partner. Make the uplift the argument that brings the next company in and the evidence behind every pricing decision.

Structure the partnerships that carry the revenue

Lead the commercial agreements with distributors, industry, fintechs and the ecosystem companies' commercial platforms, from first conversation to signed terms, and the co-investment models that align their incentives with the partner's.

Build and lead the team

Hire and develop a small go-to-market and revenue team, growth on the merchant side, monetisation and analytics, and set its standard for rigour, ownership and candour.

WHAT YOU BRING

  • Ten or more years in go-to-market, revenue or commercial strategy, with at least one commercial function built from scratch and grown to scale.

  • Hands-on experience with pricing and packaging, ideally for marketplaces, retail media, payments or SaaS sold to small businesses.

  • Experience on more than one side of a marketplace: merchants or sellers, brands or suppliers, the platform itself.

  • A track record of adoption at scale with a long tail of small customers, not only of large enterprise deals.

  • Proven ability to move a result through teams that do not report to you, and to work inside another company's channel.

  • Fluency with data: you build the business case, run the analysis and read the uplift yourself, and use AI tooling as a normal part of how you work.

  • Candour, humility and patience: you say what the numbers say, you arrive to learn before you teach.

  • English required; Portuguese or Spanish strongly preferred.

WHAT WE OFFER

  • Global impact: a product that reaches five million small businesses across Latin America, Europe and India.

  • Ownership: the commercial model of a new business, with the numbers to be judged on and the autonomy to build it.

  • Growth: exposure to the leadership of the group and of its companies, and a clear path into operating roles in the ecosystem.

  • Competitive compensation and the Prosus benefits package for the location of the role.

Why Prosus?

At Prosus, your colleagues include 60,000 AI agents… and your job is to figure out what that actually means. We're one of the largest operators of agentic AI on the planet, inside a $100B+ portfolio across 100+ companies and two billion people. The humans here own what AI can't do alone: judgment, creativity, and the call on what gets built next.

Own the impact. Work the ecosystem. Earn your growth. Build with backing.

Curious about our perks and benefits? Take a look at this page.

Our Diversity & Inclusion Commitment

We respect the dignity and human rights of individuals and communities wherever we operate in the world. Building an inclusive workplace where everyone feels welcome and can thrive is critical for us. We provide access to education, which helps everyone understand the important role they play and the positive impact they can have.

Want to know more about life at Prosus? Explore our culture and values.

data.title: Engineering Manager
data.description:
We have real traction and proven scale, and we're now setting up how engineering works for our next wave of European growth. You would lead one of the teams doing it, and shape the practices the others follow.

ABOUT THE ROLE

You would lead one of our product engineering teams: what it ships, how it runs, and how the people in it grow. Product and engineering together are ~25 people, so there is nowhere to hide and nothing you can't reach.

It's a hands-on role. One week you're in a design review, the next - in a few Claude-enabled contributions, the next - in performance conversations, and most weeks - all of that combined. You should love zooming in and out, from feedback on an API spec to a quarter's priorities. Your team trusts your technical judgement because you still use it.

Beyond your team, you would shape how engineering works at Insify together with the other Engineering Managers, a Staff Engineer and the VP Engineering: architecture, product discovery, how engineers grow.


What you'll be doing
  • Leading a team of product engineers end to end: what you ship, how it performs in production, and who you hire and grow to get there
  • Bringing architecture and product thinking into the team's daily work, so that new product demands turn into platform capabilities that scale across countries and insurance products, rather than one-off builds
  • Running product discovery with your team: working with the Insurance, Operations and Growth teams on what to build, and saying no when the answer is no
  • Shaping company-wide engineering practices alongside the other Engineering Managers: ways of working, architecture & technology practices, the growth framework
  • Challenging our ideas and bringing your own. We encourage each other to act this way, so you can expect the same from others

    • What you'll need
  • You've managed a team of engineers before, including hiring, feedback and growing people. It doesn't have to be for long, but it has to be real and you have to want more of it
  • Years of hands-on experience designing and running distributed systems, including time spent maintaining what you designed. You can still carry an architecture discussion and review a design, and your team would trust your judgement on it
  • A track record of shaping what gets built, not only how: you've run or driven product discovery, cut scope, and can show the decisions that followed
  • Ownership & impact instinct - when needed you go beyond your team's boundaries to get to results
  • You set the bar for AI adoption on your team. You use it to real effect in your own work, you're honest about where it helped and where it fell short, and you're the first to try new tools, bringing the ones that stick to your engineers.

    • Nice to have
  • You are eager to scale your experience beyond your team - to create wider organisational impact
  • Experience building B2B products, especially in insurance & fintech
  • Experience working on a product distributed across different country markets
  • Experience with TypeScript and AWS

    • Our stack
  • TypeScript across the board, running on AWS with infrastructure as code, in a single monorepo.

    • None of this is a hard requirement, and you don't need to know all of our stack. We care more about how you reason about systems and teams than which tools you have used. Strong on most of it? Apply.


    We offer
  • Competitive compensation. We offer a salary in the range of 85k-110k EUR plus performance-based equity grants
  • Hybrid. 3 days in the office, 2 from home, up to 4 weeks a year from abroad, 25 holiday days
  • Pension. 6% employer contribution
  • Wellbeing budget. €50 net a month via Epassi, from the gym to takeaway, rolls over
  • Learning and coaching. Internal leadership programs and coaching
  • Central Amsterdam office. Shared lunches, dogs, Friday drinks, high-spec MacBook Pro

    • HOW WE HIRE

    Five conversations, each with a clear purpose, and you hear where you stand after every one:

    • Leadership. We look at your experience with performance management, personal development and building teams.
    • Code Review. You review a feature with two of our engineers.
    • System Design. An architecture problem close to what we deal with.
    • Values Interview. We look at your approach to work, and how it adds to our Values.
    • Meet the Founder.

    You get the outcome within three days of your last round, with specific feedback either way.

    ABOUT INSIFY

    Insify is a high-growth scale-up backed by €43M in total funding from world-class investors like Accel, Munich Re Ventures, and Formula 1 champion Nico Rosberg. In five years, we've expanded from the Netherlands into France and Germany, and we're just getting started. Our mission: become the European leader in AI-powered SME insurance.

    We aren't just building a company; we're leading a revolution. Our culture is intense, high-stakes, and mission-driven. We hire smart, ambitious "owners" who possess a relentless drive to win. This is an environment for those who thrive on challenges, value intellectual honesty, and share our mindset of becoming a global category leader.

    Our founding team consists of seasoned entrepreneurs who have previously built iconic businesses like HelloFresh, Bloomon, and SumUp. We bring that same bias for speed, scale, and high standards to one of the most structurally broken experiences in financial services. Together, we combine that deep fintech and e-commerce expertise with cutting-edge AI to stay ahead of the curve.

Maintaining our start-up spirit, we prioritize thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and, of course, our business.

About The Role

About the role

We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst, Lifecycle to own measurement and experimentation for how new customers activate and existing ones stay.The metrics are yours whatever the lever: CRM campaigns, promos and incentives, onboarding changes in the product, and a next best action layer that decides what each customer should see next. You decide what we test, how we test it and what we do with the answer. You also bring your own hypotheses on where the next win is.

 


What You'll Do

What you'll do

Join activation and retention initiatives before anything is built, whether they come from CRM, growth or product. Define the primary metric, check against historical data whether the effect is detectable at our volumes, and turn solution-shaped requests into problem-shaped ones.

Design and analyse experiments end to end: hypothesis, guardrails, audience split, MDE and power, stopping rule, and a readout that ends in ship, iterate or kill. 

Correct for channel and engagement bias (not everyone opens email, and open and click populations are self-selected). When a clean A/B is impossible, use causal inference: diff-in-diff, matching, synthetic control or geo designs.

Bring hypotheses of your own. Launch a few new experiments across onboarding and the customer lifecycle, and turn one-off wins into recurring segmented flows.

Build deliberately simple models: segmentation, propensity, churn and dormancy scoring. They feed audiences, personalisation and incentive targeting. Over time these come together into next best action: for a given customer, which offer, feature nudge or message to send next, through which channel, and whether to send anything at all. You own the logic and the measurement of whether it beats the current rules.

Automate your own recurring work: audience refresh jobs, readout templates, dashboards for Activation, Onboarding and Retention. Ship models the Databricks way (scheduled jobs write tables, tables map into downstream tools such as Braze) and bring engagement data back into the warehouse to close the loop.


What You Bring

What you bring

  • Strong SQL and Python, and a Git-based warehouse workflow with code review.

  • Experiment design, statistics and metric design you can defend.

  • BI experience, Power BI/Tableau or similar.

  • Stakeholder management and business sense: you can push back, reframe a request and land a recommendation with a non-technical audience.

  • Curiosity and ownership. You run your area without waiting to be asked.

    •  


    Nice To Have

    Nice to have

  • Causal inference methods and a clear sense of when each one is valid.

  • Clustering and segmentation that ends up in use, not in a slide.

  • Predictive modelling with honest validation. Uplift modelling is a plus.

  • Braze or a comparable CRM platform: audiences, canvases, native split testing, channel mechanics and their biases.

data.title: Data & AI Governance Consultant
data.description:
Help organisaties om data en AI verantwoord, betrouwbaar en effectief in te zetten.

Data- en AI-governance is meer dan beleid en procedures. Het zorgt ervoor dat organisaties grip krijgen op hun data, betere beslissingen nemen en AI op een verantwoorde manier kunnen inzetten.

Bij adesso helpen we organisaties om datagedreven en AI-gedreven werken duurzaam te organiseren. Niet door alleen modellen en policies te introduceren, maar door governance te verbinden aan businesswaarde, adoptie en de dagelijkse praktijk.

Als Data & AI Governance Consultant help jij klanten om structuur aan te brengen, eigenaarschap te organiseren en hun datamanagement en AI-governance verder te professionaliseren. Je vertaalt complexe vraagstukken naar praktische oplossingen die daadwerkelijk werken.

Jouw rol

Jij brengt structuur in complexe data- en AI-vraagstukken. Je helpt organisaties om hun governanceprocessen te verbeteren, verantwoordelijkheden helder te maken en data beter te benutten.

Je werkt zelfstandig aan analyses, workshops en verbeterinitiatieven en schakelt daarbij met stakeholders uit business en IT. Samen met collega's en klanten vertaal je strategische doelstellingen naar concrete acties.

Je krijgt de ruimte om verantwoordelijkheid te nemen, je expertise te verdiepen en steeds meer zelfstandig klanten te adviseren.


Wat je doet

Data- en AI-governance

  • Je adviseert klanten over data governance, datamanagement en verantwoord gebruik van AI.

  • Je helpt bij het ontwerpen en implementeren van governance operating models, inclusief rollen, verantwoordelijkheden en besluitvorming.

  • Je voert zelfstandig maturity assessments uit en vertaalt de resultaten naar concrete verbeteradviezen.

  • Je ondersteunt bij het ontwikkelen van datastrategieën, governanceprincipes, policies en praktische roadmaps.

  • Je helpt organisaties om data ownership en data stewardship goed in te richten.

Data quality, metadata & AI

  • Je analyseert en verbetert processen rondom datakwaliteit, metadata en data lineage.

  • Je helpt bij het definiëren van kwaliteitsafspraken, KPI's en verantwoordelijkheden.

  • Je werkt samen met data engineers, architecten en andere specialisten om governancevraagstukken te vertalen naar werkbare oplossingen.

  • Je onderzoekt hoe AI en automatisering datamanagementprocessen kunnen verbeteren.

  • Je houdt rekening met privacy, security, Responsible AI en relevante wet- en regelgeving, zoals de EU AI Act.

Consultancy & stakeholdermanagement

  • Je faciliteert workshops met business- en IT-stakeholders om behoeften, knelpunten en verbeterkansen in kaart te brengen.

  • Je vertaalt zakelijke doelstellingen naar concrete governance-initiatieven en meetbare resultaten.

  • Je presenteert analyses, bevindingen en aanbevelingen op een duidelijke en overtuigende manier.

  • Je ondersteunt klanten bij het invoeren van nieuwe processen en werkwijzen en helpt draagvlak te creëren.

  • Je signaleert kansen voor aanvullende dienstverlening en bespreekt deze met je team.

Samenwerking & ontwikkeling

  • Je neemt zelfstandig verantwoordelijkheid voor onderdelen van klantprojecten en bewaakt de voortgang en kwaliteit van je werkzaamheden.

  • Je werkt nauw samen met collega's uit verschillende disciplines en schakelt tijdig wanneer ondersteuning nodig is.

  • Je gebruikt AI-tools waar ze waarde toevoegen en beoordeelt de uitkomsten kritisch, met aandacht voor vertrouwelijkheid en dataveiligheid.

  • Je deelt kennis, begeleidt waar mogelijk minder ervaren collega's en draagt bij aan de ontwikkeling van onze dienstverlening.


Wat jij meebrengt
Je bent analytisch sterk, nieuwsgierig en weet complexe onderwerpen begrijpelijk te maken. Je vindt het leuk om met klanten samen te werken en krijgt energie van het verbeteren van processen en organisaties.

  • Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding, bijvoorbeeld in Bedrijfskunde, Informatiekunde, Informatica of een vergelijkbare richting.

  • Minimaal 3 jaar relevante ervaring binnen data governance, datamanagement of dataconsultancy.

  • Kennis van data governance, data quality, data stewardship en governanceprocessen.

  • Ervaring met het uitvoeren van analyses, begeleiden van workshops of adviseren van stakeholders.

  • Begrip van data-architectuur, datamodellering en de samenwerking tussen business en IT.

  • Interesse in AI-governance en het verantwoord toepassen van AI binnen organisaties.

  • Je gebruikt AI zelf in je werk en onderzoekt graag hoe het slimmer kan.

  • Je werkt zelfstandig, neemt initiatief en weet wanneer je collega's moet betrekken.

  • Goede communicatieve vaardigheden en het vermogen om verschillende belangen samen te brengen.

  • Een uitstekende beheersing van het Nederlands en Engels.

Mooi meegenomen

  • Ervaring met maturity assessments, governance operating models of het opstellen van RACI's.

  • Kennis van DAMA-DMBOK of een CDMP-certificering, of de ambitie om deze te behalen.

  • Ervaring met datacatalogustools zoals Microsoft Purview, Collibra of Alation.

  • Kennis van metadata, data lineage en data quality frameworks.

data.description:

Wat ga je doen?

Als Medior AI Engineer werk je samen met senior AI Engineers en Forward Deployed Engineers aan klantprojecten. Je pakt zelfstandig onderdelen op en groeit in architectuur en end-to-end verantwoordelijkheid.

  • Van idee naar productie: je bouwt data- en ML-pipelines, automatiseert deployments en zorgt voor monitoring en betrouwbaarheid.

  • Slim integreren: je koppelt AI aan bestaande systemen, API's en cloud- en dataplatformen.

  • Meedenken met de klant: je vertaalt vraagstukken naar praktische, schaalbare oplossingen.

  • Kennis delen: je legt herbruikbare patronen vast en deelt wat je leert met je collega's.

Projecten die verder gaan dan het model

We richten ons op retail en e-commerce, finance en utilities. Denk aan:

  • Prognoses waar planners op durven te sturen, van retailassortiment tot netbelasting.

  • Intelligente documentverwerking, zoals KYC-dossiers of inspectierapporten, met herleidbare bronnen.

  • Agents die werk voorbereiden in klantenservice en backoffice, met evals en guardrails.

  • Computer vision, zoals in de fitnessbranche, waar we onveilige situaties in onbemande 24/7-locaties herkennen.

De uitdaging zit niet alleen in het model, maar ook in betrouwbaarheid, integratie en de werking in de praktijk. Je kiest steeds de techniek die bij het probleem past.

  • Geen GenAI omdat het kan. Soms is een klassiek model beter, soms een LLM; jij kiest wat past.

  • Geen werk op afroep. Je denkt vanaf de klantvraag mee, niet pas als het ontwerp al vastligt.

Je wordt onderdeel van ons AI Engineering-team: AI engineering consultants in twee rollen. data.title: Teamleider Electromagnetic Warfare (m/v/x)
data.description:
Ben jij die ambitieuze Teamleider / R&D engineer die graag helpt om civiele en militaire vliegtuigen veilig, duurzaam en competitief te laten vliegen? Wil jij jezelf verder ontwikkelen en word je enthousiast van techniek, innovatie en duurzaamheid? Wij zijn op zoek naar een teamleider voor de afdeling.

Wat ga je doen?

In een wereld waarin lucht- en ruimtevaartsystemen steeds complexer worden, is het belangrijk om innovatieve oplossingen te ontwikkelen om de veiligheid en efficiëntie te garanderen. Binnen NLR werken we aan de ontwikkeling van geavanceerde aerospace systemen. We maken hierbij gebruik van software modelering en simulatie om het gedrag van complexe systemen te begrijpen en te optimaliseren.

Onze expertise in hardware testen en operationele ondersteuning (OPS) zorgt ervoor dat onze oplossingen niet alleen theoretisch solide zijn, maar ook praktisch toepasbaar en robuust.

De belangstelling voor Electromagnetic Warfare (EW) neemt toe, met de noodzaak om onze lucht- en ruimtevaartsystemen te beschermen tegen elektromagnetische bedreigingen. We zoeken hierom een teamleider binnen onze nieuwe afdeling Aerospace Systems Electronic Warfare (ASEW)

Als teamleider EW zal je leiding geven aan een team van professionals met expertise in het ontwerp, de ontwikkeling en het testen van aerospace systemen met focus op Electronic Warfare.

Binnen onze nieuwe afdeling Aerospace Systems Electromagnetic Warfare zoeken wij een ervaren en gedreven Teamleider om ons team te leiden en te inspireren. De afdeling is gericht op het ontwikkelen van innovatieve oplossingen voor Electromagnetic Warfare (EW) en heeft als doel om de Nederlandse en internationale lucht- en ruimtevaartindustrie te ondersteunen.

Als Teamleider binnen onze afdeling ASEW ben je verantwoordelijk voor het leiden en ontwikkelen van een team van specialisten op het gebied van EW. Je werkt nauw samen met de Afdelingsmanager en andere teams binnen NLR om onze doelen te bereiken.

In afstemming met de Afdelingsmanager ASEW zal je één van de twee Electromagnetic Warfare kennisgebied overzien, namelijk Electronic Warfare Modelling and Simulation of Electronic Warfare Analyses.

In de rol van teamleider blijf je actief en inhoudelijk betrokken bij het uitvoeren van projecten en krijg je de coördinatie over een team van technische collega’s en het verder ontwikkelen en uitbouwen van de faciliteiten waarvoor ASEW verantwoordelijk is. Je bent dus zowel een teamleider als een R&D Engineer.

Als teamleider …

Als teamleider bied jij het team alles wat nodig is om de werkzaamheden van jouw team succesvol te laten verlopen. Je bent de directe leidinggevende van betreffende collega’s en draagt ook de HR-verantwoordelijkheid. Je coacht, stuurt, geeft én vraagt feedback en je pakt de leiding wanneer nodig.

Je stelt hen op deze wijze in staat om optimaal aan de projecten te werken en faciliteer jij hen waar nodig. Je zorgt voor het versterken van de kennispositie van het werkgebied en de realisatie van de werkzaamheden/opdrachten voor interne en externe stakeholders.

Je hebt een open en enthousiasmerende stijl van leidinggeven. Je collega’s voelen zich vrij en gesteund en kunnen zichzelf goed ontwikkelen. Er wordt een goede teamspirit ervaren. Je zorgt voor een goede aansluiting van het werkgebied bij de rest van ASEW en voor het zoeken van synergie met andere afdelingen binnen flight test en certificatie. Je versterkt de samenwerkingsrelaties gericht op het verder volwassen laten worden van het team.

Als R&D Engineer…

Als R&D engineer EW werk je mee aan het veiliger, duurzamer en competitiever maken van de militaire en civiele luchtvaart. Je werkt aan vliegtuigen, helikopters en onbemande vliegende systemen.

Je ondersteunt onze binnen- en buitenlandse opdrachtgevers bij het bereiken van hun doelen. Je voert testen uit, genereerd modellen en analyseert resultaten.

In de rol van R&D engineer, trek of draag je inhoudelijk bij aan projectvoorstellen voor bijvoorbeeld betaalde projecten in opdracht van een (externe) stakeholder. Dit kunnen ook onderzoeksvoorstellen zijn voor bijvoorbeeld defensie onderzoeks-calls.

Verantwoordelijkheden

  • Leiden en ontwikkelen van een team van specialisten op het gebied van EW;

  • Samenwerken met de Afdelingsmanager ASEW en andere teams binnen NLR om onze doelen te bereiken;

  • Overzien van een kennisgebied (Electronic Warfare Modelling and Simulation of Electronic Warfare Analyses) waarmee je samen met de Afdelingsmanager tot strategische doelen van het team komt;

  • Inspireren en motiveren van teamleden om hun beste werk te leveren;

  • Coördineren van projecten en activiteiten om de doelen van de afdeling te bereiken.

Wat breng je mee?

  • Een afgeronde WO master in een relevante discipline (bijv. lucht- en ruimtevaarttechniek, elektrotechniek, informatica);

  • Tenminste 3 jaar ervaring in een leidinggevende functie, bij voorkeur in de lucht- en ruimtevaartindustrie;

  • Aantoonbare kennis en ervaring op het gebied van EW;

  • Uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden in zowel het Nederlands als het Engels (tenminste op C1 niveau);

  • Sterke leiderschaps- en coachingsvaardigheden;

  • In staat om een team te inspireren en te motiveren om hun beste werk te leveren.

Wat bieden wij jou?

Werken bij NLR, betekent werken in een nationale en internationale hightech omgeving. Samenwerken en betrokkenheid staan bij ons hoog in vaandel. Door jou vrijheid en eigen verantwoordelijkheid te geven, ben jij het best in staat om tot baanbrekende innovaties te komen. Wil jij jezelf vakinhoudelijk én op persoonlijk vlak ontwikkelen? Ook dat kan bij NLR als lerende organisatie, met daarnaast een opleidingsbudget, een mentor, interne coaches en goede contacten met mbo’s, hbo’s en universiteiten.

Naast dit alles bieden wij jou:

  • De kans om bij te dragen aan complexe en maatschappelijk relevante vraagstukken;

  • Voldoende vakantie- en ATV-dagen (in totaal 45 bij fulltime dienstverband) voor een goede werk-privébalans;

  • Een eindejaarsuitkering van 8%;

  • Een tegemoetkoming in jouw zorgkosten;

  • Extra betaald ouderschapsverlof;

  • De mogelijkheid om jezelf te ontwikkelen met opleidingen en cursussen die passen bij jouw ambities.

Jouw nieuwe werkomgeving

Electromagnetic Warfare is een nieuwe afdeling binnen Aerospace systems en is voort gekomen uit de afdeling Defence Operations. Je zult de leidinggevende zijn van een team enthousiaste en gedreven professionals. Hierbij zul je nauw samenwerken met andere NLR afdelingen, in het bijzonder de afdeling waaruit ASEW voortgekomen is. De werkzaamheden zijn direct gerelateerd aan Defensie, weerbaarheid en de verdediging van Nederland en de Nederlandse krijgsmacht.

Je werkt vanuit onze locatie in Amsterdam en zult veel contact met collega's en partners binnen en buiten NLR.

Wat betekent werken bij NLR?

Koninklijke NLR is al ruim 100 jaar een kennisorganisatie met de wil en ambitie om te vernieuwen. Vanuit die drijfveer maken wij de wereld van lucht- en ruimtevaart veiliger, duurzamer, efficiënter en effectiever en staan wij voor baanbrekende innovaties.

Bij ons werken meer dan 1000 gedreven professionals, van vliegtuigbouwkundigen tot psychologen en van wiskundigen tot applicatiedeskundigen. NLR staat voor een inclusieve en diverse organisatie waar iedereen zich welkom, veilig, gewaardeerd en gerespecteerd voelt.

Wil jij meer weten?


Bel of mail dan met Frank Bax (recruiter) via 0615676915 of .

Onze collega’s vertellen jou graag hoe het is om bij NLR te werken. Vergeet trouwens ook niet eens een kijkje op onze socials te nemen zoals ons YouTube kanaal.

Solliciteren?

Mooi, we zijn benieuwd naar jou! Stuur je motivatiebrief en CV via de ‘Solliciteren’ button.

De teamleider is een parttime functie.

Een assessment maakt deel uit van de procedure. 

Een positieve uitkomst van een veiligheidsonderzoek (VGB) is een voorwaarde voor indiensttreding. Meer informatie daarover lees je op de website van de MIVD.

Acquisitie wordt niet op prijs gesteld!

data.title: Junior International Sales & Business Development Representative – DACH Market
data.description:
Empowering organizations in IT risk management

Securance helps organizations build resilience and security, enabling them to provide assurance to stakeholders on IT risk management and cybersecurity. Based in Utrecht, the team works to structurally improve security for clients operating in the DACH market.

Your responsibilitiesJunior International Sales & Partnership Representative – DACH Market

Full-time Graduate Position / Part-time Working Student

📍 Utrecht, The Netherlands
🌍 International Sales & Marketing Team
🇩🇪 DACH Market – Germany, Austria & Switzerland

Your market is DACH. Your team is international. Your career starts in Utrecht.

Are you a German-speaking student or recent graduate looking for an exciting start to your international career?

Would you like to work with colleagues from different countries, build business relationships, visit industry events and learn what professional B2B sales and partnership management are really about?

Welcome to Securance!

We are looking for an enthusiastic Junior International Sales & Partnership Representative to join our international Sales & Marketing team in Utrecht, the Netherlands.

Whether you're finishing your studies or have recently graduated, we offer you the opportunity to develop your commercial skills, build an international network and gain hands-on experience in business development.

One team. Many nationalities. Different markets.

At Securance, international collaboration isn't just something we talk about. It's how we work every day.

Our sales team brings together colleagues from different countries and cultural backgrounds. Each team member focuses on developing business in their own home market, combining local knowledge and language skills with the strength of an international organization.

We work side by side in Utrecht, sharing experiences, exchanging ideas and supporting each other.

As our German-speaking representative, you'll focus on developing our business and partnerships across the DACH region.

You'll also work closely with our colleagues in Germany, travelling there regularly when needed to collaborate with the local team, meet partners, attend events and support commercial opportunities.

Your home base is Utrecht, but your professional network will extend across borders.

Learn Consultative Sales and Partnership Management from experienced professionals

At Securance, we believe successful business development starts with understanding people, their organizations and their challenges.

We don't focus on simply pushing products or closing quick deals. Instead, we practice Consultative Sales: asking the right questions, understanding customer needs, identifying opportunities and developing solutions that create long-term value.

You'll also learn how to build and manage strategic business partnerships, develop professional networks and turn relationships into meaningful commercial opportunities.

Our experienced and innovative team will coach you, involve you in real business activities and help you develop your own professional approach.

We don't expect you to know everything when you join. We expect you to be curious, motivated and eager to learn.

Our ambition is to help you become genuinely good at professional B2B sales, business development and partnership management.

What will you be doing?

As part of our international team, you will:

  • Business Development: Identify potential customers, new business opportunities and commercial prospects in the DACH region.

  • Consultative Sales: Connect with decision-makers, understand their challenges and learn how to develop valuable business solutions.

  • Partnership Management: Help build, develop and maintain relationships with business partners, referral partners and other relevant organizations.

  • Events & Networking: Attend industry conferences, networking events, trade fairs and business meetings to represent Securance and expand our professional network.

  • International Collaboration: Work closely with your international colleagues in Utrecht and regularly visit Germany to collaborate with the German team when needed.

  • Relationship Management: Support the development of long-term relationships with customers and partners.

  • Sales & Marketing: Contribute to commercial campaigns, market research, lead generation and international business development initiatives.

  • Market Development: Gradually take greater ownership of commercial activities and partnership opportunities in your market.

From day one, you'll be involved in real business activities, supported by experienced colleagues.

Who are we looking for?

We're looking for someone with potential, personality and a strong willingness to learn.

You:

  • Are in the final year of your studies or have recently graduated.

  • Speak German at native or near-native level and understand the German-speaking business environment.

  • Have good English communication skills, as English is our international working language.

  • Live in the Netherlands or are willing to relocate to the Utrecht area.

  • Enjoy meeting people, networking and building professional relationships.

  • Are curious, proactive, enthusiastic and commercially minded.

  • Enjoy working with colleagues from different nationalities and cultures.

  • Are interested in B2B sales, business development and partnership management.

  • Are comfortable attending business events and travelling to Germany regularly when required.

Previous sales experience is not required. Your attitude, motivation and willingness to learn matter much more.

What can you expect from Securance?

A genuinely international workplace

Work alongside colleagues from different countries, each bringing their own perspectives, experience and market knowledge.

Excellent professional development

Receive practical training, personal coaching and guidance from experienced sales and business development professionals.

International exposure and travel

Visit Germany to collaborate with local colleagues, meet partners and customers, and attend relevant industry events.

Build your professional network

Develop relationships with companies, industry professionals and business partners across the DACH region.

Real responsibility

Contribute to developing your own market, commercial relationships and partnership opportunities.

An innovative professional environment

Learn about cybersecurity, risk management, IT assurance and related professional services.

Opportunities for students and graduates

We welcome recent graduates interested in a full-time position and final-year students looking to combine their studies with meaningful part-time work.

A collaborative team culture

Become part of a team that shares knowledge, celebrates success and helps each other grow.

About Securance

Securance is an international professional services organization specializing in cybersecurity, risk management, IT assurance and related advisory services.

We help organizations understand risks, strengthen controls and build confidence in their business and technology environments.

Our international approach combines professional expertise with local market understanding, strategic partnerships and long-term customer relationships.

As part of our commercial team, you'll learn how to translate complex business challenges into valuable conversations, business opportunities and sustainable partnerships.

Ready to start your international career?

If you're German-speaking, internationally minded and excited to develop your skills in sales, business development and partnership management, we'd love to meet you.

Join our international team in Utrecht. Build relationships across borders. Start your career with Securance.

Apply now!

Location: Utrecht, The Netherlands. This is an office-based international team position, involving regular business travel to Germany when required. It is not a remote position based in Germany.

data.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer - SAP Connectors
Data Analist E-commerce
data.description:
Als Data Analist e-commerce ben jij dé analytics expert die data omzet in waardevolle commerciële inzichten. Je zorgt ervoor dat het E-commerce team kan sturen op betrouwbare inzichten en helpt collega's om betere beslissingen te nemen over onze website, app, assortiment, content en commerciële prestaties. Kortom: je krijgt veel verantwoordelijkheid in een uitdagende rol.

Je bouwt mee aan de analytics-omgeving van My Jewellery en deze geef jij zelf mede vorm. Je bouwt niet direct wat er gevraagd wordt. Je daagt je collega’s uit en vormt gezamenlijk een plan welke inzichten nodig zijn en hoe jij die inzichten het beste kan bouwen en delen met je collega’s. Dit kan bijvoorbeeld een analyse zijn, een dashboard, een rekenmodel of een automatische e-mail feed met verbeter suggesties. Zo bouw je mee aan een My Jewellery dat stuurt op de juiste inzichten en leg je de basis voor de verdere groei van ons merk. 

Daarnaast duik je in commerciële vraagstukken. Je onderzoekt waarom conversie verandert, welke productcategorieën het beste presteren, waar bezoekers afhaken in de funnel en welke experimenten daadwerkelijk bijdragen aan omzet en marge. Je denkt actief mee over verbeterkansen, daagt aannames uit en vertaalt analyses naar concrete acties met aantoonbare business impact.

In deze rol werk je intensief samen met collega's van E-commerce, CRO, Product, IT, Finance en Marketing & Customer Analytics. Samen bouwen jullie aan een data gedreven organisatie waarin analyses niet alleen inzicht geven, maar vooral leiden tot betere commerciële keuzes.

Jouw taken

  • Je ontwikkelt een betrouwbare analyticsomgeving en je zorgt voor eenduidige definities voor commerciële KPI's zoals conversie, omzet, marge en returns;

  • Je bouwt datamodellen en dashboards voor website-, app-, funnel- en productperformance;

  • Je analyseert conversie, funnelprestaties, productcategorieën en commerciële kansen en vertaalt deze naar concrete adviezen;

  • Je bouwt AI coding oplossingen om je eigen werk efficiënter en effectiever te maken;

  • Je bewaakt de kwaliteit van data, onderzoekt verschillen tussen databronnen en zorgt voor betrouwbare inzichten;

  • Je werkt als businesspartner samen met E-commerce, CRO, Product, IT, Finance en Marketing om datagedreven besluitvorming verder te ontwikkelen.


  • Je hebt minimaal 2 jaar ervaring binnen e-commerce, digital of product analytics;

  • Je hebt goede SQL-vaardigheden en kunt zelfstandig datamodellen, analyses en dashboards ontwikkelen;

  • Je weet commerciële vraagstukken te vertalen naar bruikbare inzichten en durft stakeholders kritisch te adviseren;

  • Je hebt kennis van statistiek en experimentanalyse en begrijpt hoe je conversie en commerciële KPI's meet en verbetert;

  • Ervaring met A/B testen, conversie optimalisatie en product analytics is een sterke pré;

  • Ervaring met dbt, Python of web- en app-tracking is een pré;

  • Je woont in Nederland.

Over My Jewellery

My Jewellery is een van de snelst groeiende merken en e-commerce bedrijven van Nederland met internationale bekendheid. We ontwikkelen collecties en campagnes die het leven van vrouwen een beetje mooier maken. Met meer dan 1.000 collega's bouwen we elke dag aan een merk vol ambitie en creativiteit. Onze cultuur? Persoonlijk, betrokken en sprankelend. Jij mag hier helemaal jezelf zijn en krijgt de ruimte om te groeien, te leren en impact te maken. Ondanks onze sterke, internationale groei blijven de lijnen kort, de structuur plat en het saamhorigheidsgevoel op hoog niveau. Als team proberen we iedere dag het verschil te maken!

data.title: Data & Insights Analyst
data.description:
Wat je over ons moet weten?

Wij zijn Athora Netherlands, een verzekeringsbedrijf met de bekende merken Zwitserleven en Reaal. Wij houden ons voornamelijk bezig met pensioenen en levensverzekeringen op de Nederlandse markt. Dat doen wij als onderdeel van een Europese groep met vestigingen in Ierland, het Verenigd Koninkrijk, België, Duitsland en Italië. Wij zijn een sterk bedrijf met ruim één miljoen klanten en wij willen de komende jaren doorgroeien tot een van de belangrijkste spelers in de snel veranderende pensioenmarkt. Daarom zoeken wij mensen die niet terugdeinzen voor verandering, die van aanpakken weten, die de ambitie hebben om resultaten neer te zetten en die daarom het beste uit zichzelf en hun team weten te halen. Slimmer samen, noemen wij dat.

Wat ga je doen?

Bij Strategy & Portfolio Management verbind je strategie, prioriteiten en resultaat. Samen met collega’s in strategie, performance, programma management help je ExCo en de domeinen om onderbouwde keuzes te maken en gericht bij te sturen. Je bouwt mee aan een team waarin samenwerking, een scherpe inhoudelijke blik en eigenaarschap centraal staan.

Maak van data inzichten die ertoe doen. Als Data & Insights Analyst vertaal je interne en externe data naar dashboards, analyses en kernboodschappen die strategie, performance, portfoliosturing en ExCo-besluitvorming ondersteunen.

Verantwoordelijkheden

  • Je ontsluit en combineert databronnen en bewaakt kwaliteit, definities en herleidbaarheid;

  • Je ontwikkelt en beheert Power BI-dashboards die strategie- en portfolioperformance inzichtelijk maken en ExCo ondersteunen bij onderbouwde besluitvorming;

  • Je vertaalt complexe data naar heldere analyses en kernboodschappen voor management en ExCo;

  • Je levert betrouwbare inzichten voor de kwartaalreviews, op basis van maandrapportages en aanvullende analyses;

  • Je verrijkt interne analyses met markt-, klant- en concurrentie-inzichten;

  • Je verdiept inzichten met scenario- en oorzaakanalyses;

  • Je signaleert trends, risico’s, afhankelijkheden en mogelijkheden om bij te sturen;

  • Je helpt data- en rapportageprocessen verbeteren en ondersteunt waar passend andere afdelingen bij dashboarding.

#LI-DN


Wat vragen we van jou?

  • Academisch werk- en denkniveau, bij voorkeur in Data Analytics, Bedrijfskunde, Economie, Informatiekunde of een vergelijkbare richting;

  • Minimaal 5 tot 7 jaar relevante ervaring met data-analyse, business intelligence, performance management of managementinformatie;

  • Aantoonbare ervaring met dashboards, rapportages en analyses, bij voorkeur met Power BI en meerdere databronnen;

  • Ervaring met het vertalen van complexe data naar begrijpelijke inzichten en stuurinformatie voor management en besluitvorming.

Daarnaast:

  • Analytisch sterk: je brengt structuur in complexe informatie en herkent patronen en verbanden;

  • Helder in communicatie: je maakt van analyses een begrijpelijk verhaal dat helpt bij keuzes;

  • Samenwerkingsgericht: je begrijpt informatiebehoeften en stemt soepel af met uiteenlopende stakeholders;

  • Kwaliteitsbewust en scherp: je bewaakt consistentie en maakt afwijkingen en datakwaliteitsproblemen bespreekbaar;

  • Resultaatgericht: je plant zorgvuldig en levert tijdig betrouwbare, praktisch bruikbare inzichten.

Wat krijg je van ons?

Je krijgt pakweg 900 collega's die allemaal vinden dat ze bij een bijzonder bedrijf werken. Je krijgt de mogelijkheid om een belangrijke bijdrage te leveren aan het maatschappelijk relevante thema van pensioenen. Wij zorgen ervoor dat je pensioen goed geregeld is, zodat je zorgeloos kan genieten van je oude dag.


Jij krijgt de kans om echt het verschil te maken als het gaat om duurzaamheid, omdat we in onze bedrijfsvoering en onze beleggingen al jaren de toon aangeven. Uiteraard krijg je een (flexibele) werkplek op ons kantoor in Amsterdam dat behoort tot de beste 7% van de wereld, echt waar. En omdat je ook regelmatig thuis zult werken, ontvang je een budget om je thuiswerkplek goed in te richten.


In ruil voor jouw inzet, talent en vaardigheden krijg je naast je salaris plus een vakantietoeslag en een dertiende maand, 27 vakantiedagen (bij een contract van 36 uur) en een OV-kaart of reiskostenvergoeding voor de dagen dat je naar kantoor komt. En, niet onbelangrijk vinden wij, krijg je een goed opleidingsbudget, zodat je jezelf kunt blijven ontwikkelen. Zo krijg je de kans om door te groeien, binnen ons bedrijf of daarbuiten.

Op basis van cao schaal 16 HAY is de range € 5.082,02 tot € 6.776,03 op basis van 36 uur.

data.title: Senior Customer Communication Strategist
data.description:
Als Senior Customer Communication Strategist word je onderdeel van het Channel Experience team binnen Customer Experience & Marketing. Je rapporteert aan de Head of Customer Experience & Marketing en maakt deel uit van het kernteam. Samen werken we aan een herkenbare, relevante en consistente klantbeleving van Zwitserleven, over alle kanalen en customer journeys.

Wat je over ons moet weten?

Wij zijn Athora Netherlands, een verzekeringsbedrijf met de bekende merken Zwitserleven en Reaal. Wij houden ons voornamelijk bezig met pensioenen en levensverzekeringen op de Nederlandse markt. Dat doen wij als onderdeel van een Europese groep met vestigingen in Ierland, het Verenigd Koninkrijk, België, Duitsland en Italië. Wij zijn een sterk bedrijf met ruim één miljoen klanten en wij willen de komende jaren doorgroeien tot een van de belangrijkste spelers in de snel veranderende pensioenmarkt. Daarom zoeken wij mensen die niet terugdeinzen voor verandering, die van aanpakken weten, die de ambitie hebben om resultaten neer te zetten en die daarom het beste uit zichzelf en hun team weten te halen. Slimmer samen, noemen wij dat.

Wat ga je doen?

Vanuit het Channel Experience team werken we nauw samen met Sales, UX, IT, Products, Legal, Compliance en Corporate Communicatie.

Als Senior Customer Communication Strategist vertaal je onze CX & Marketing-visie naar communicatie die herkenbaar Zwitserleven is. Je verbindt merk, klant, pensioen en communicatie en zorgt dat het gevoel van Zwitserleven terugkomt in onze Tone of Voice, customer journeys en commerciële verhalen.

Je kent de pensioenwereld en weet complexe inhoud terug te brengen tot heldere, menselijke en relevante communicatie. Je vertegenwoordigt daarbij het klant- en merkperspectief richting Legal, Compliance en Products en zorgt samen voor een passende vertaling waarin klantbelang, merk en wettelijke vereisten samenkomen.


Ook commercieel breng je ons verhaal tot leven. Je kunt onze customer journeys overtuigend uitleggen, ontwikkelt sterke pitchdecks en presentaties en ondersteunt Sales bij belangrijke pitches. Waar relevant presenteer je zelf het CX-, merk- en journeyverhaal van Zwitserleven.

Daarnaast kijk je vooruit. Je benut AI, GenAI en personalisatie om communicatie slimmer, relevanter en persoonlijker te maken, zonder het menselijke karakter en de herkenbare Tone of Voice van Zwitserleven uit het oog te verliezen.

Belangrijkste verantwoordelijkheden:

- Je vertaalt de CX & Marketing-strategie naar sterke communicatieconcepten en klantverhalen.
- Je bent een sparringpartner voor ons nieuwe Business Strategie team omtrent proposities.
- Je bewaakt en ontwikkelt de Tone of Voice van Zwitserleven en vertaalt het merkgevoel naar communicatie en klantinteracties,
- Je zorgt er samen met Products, Legal en Compliance voor dat onze klantcommunicatie voldoet aan geldende wet- en regelgeving en compliancekaders, en borgt dit binnen de customer journeys.
- Je borgt de vertaling van onze duurzaamheidsambities naar marketingactiviteiten en -uitingen en zorgt dat duurzaamheidscommunicatie actueel, consistent en passend blijft.

- Je maakt complexe pensioenmaterie begrijpelijk, menselijk en relevant voor de klant.
- Je versterkt customer journeys vanuit communicatie en kunt het verhaal en de keuzes erachter overtuigend uitleggen.
- Je ontwikkelt pitchdecks en presentaties waarin merk, proposities, journeys en klantbeleving samenkomen en ondersteunt Sales bij belangrijke pitches.
- Je stemt met Corporate Communicatie af over Athora-brede communicatie, pers en reputatie.
- Je benut AI en GenAI, waaronder LLM's, voor onder andere content, personalisatie en Tone of Voice en vertaalt nieuwe ontwikkelingen naar concrete toepassingen.

#LI-DNI


Wat vragen we van jou?

Je bent een senior communicatieprofessional die strategisch sterk, taalgevoelig en merkgedreven is. Je denkt vanuit de klant, doorgrondt complexe inhoud snel en weet verschillende belangen met elkaar te verbinden.

Je hebt:

- Minimaal 5 jaar relevante werkervaring binnen communicatie, content, marketing of Customer Experience.
- aantoonbare kennis van pensioen
- WO werk- en denkniveau
